_readme: Presentation-only timeline summaries, derived from the existing event source notes. These are not new reviewed evidence. Each entry requires an exact match on institution, date, source_url and source_note; changed or new notes fall back to their full text until summarized. Titles and bullets must preserve scope, attribution and deployment status. The original event remains available in the UI.

entries.source_note: July offsite: management and board agree CalSTRS should position as an 'Early Adopter' on the AI innovation curve
entries.title: Board backs early AI adoption
bullets: Management and trustees agree to position CalSTRS as an early adopter of AI.

entries.source_note: AI use-case inventory: 25 candidate use cases documented across 10+ business programs (6 in investments)
entries.title: 25 candidate AI use cases identified
bullets: The inventory spans more than ten business programs, including six potential investment applications.

entries.source_note: Board launches collaborative board-and-staff Technology-AI working group to define board oversight role
entries.title: Board and staff form AI working group
bullets: The group will define the board’s oversight role for technology and AI.

entries.source_note: GenAI policy, cost-benefit analysis, and pipeline of scalable use cases presented to board; staff AI bootcamp set for September
entries.title: GenAI policy and use-case pipeline presented
bullets: Staff bring governance, cost-benefit analysis and potential applications to the board; an AI bootcamp is planned for September.

entries.source_note: CEO recommends embedding AI oversight into existing board governance; formal AI governance principles to be set at July 2026 offsite
entries.title: CEO proposes AI oversight within existing governance
bullets: Formal principles are scheduled for the July offsite; this is a governance recommendation, not a deployment announcement.

entries.source_note: Board education day: 'Reinvention with Generative AI' intro session led by Accenture (what GenAI is, its importance, public-sector examples)
entries.title: Trustees receive introductory GenAI training
bullets: Accenture leads a board education session covering the technology and public-sector examples.

entries.source_note: Board education briefing from Jefferies — AI as a macro/investment phenomenon (US/China tech race, capex, power), led by CIO Stephen Gilmore
entries.title: Board briefing examines AI investment trends
bullets: Jefferies discusses technology competition, capital expenditure and power demand; the session does not establish internal AI deployment.

entries.source_note: Publishes 'Responsible AI' position paper (board accountability, transparency, risk management)
entries.title: Responsible AI position paper published
bullets: The paper sets out expectations for board accountability, transparency and risk management.

entries.source_note: ~50% of 700 staff building their own Claude tools; roadmap toward supervised-autonomous agents
entries.title: Staff build their own Claude tools
bullets: About half of 700 employees reportedly build tools; supervised autonomous agents remain on the roadmap.

entries.source_note: Tangen: 3-year firm-wide AI push, benefits already 'in the billions' (company claim)
entries.title: Tangen reports benefits from firm-wide AI push
bullets: The CEO describes three years of adoption and benefits “in the billions”; this is a company claim.

entries.source_note: At the Storting hearing on the management of the Government Pension Fund Global, Tangen states that all 680 employees use AI daily and more than half use coding tools and write code themselves, claims productivity gains of over 20%, and attributes part of a 30% reduction in trading costs 2023-2025 (NOK 4.8bn) to the technology
entries.title: Daily AI use reported across all 680 employees
bullets: Tangen claims productivity gains above 20% and attributes part of the 2023–2025 trading-cost reduction to AI.

entries.source_note: IPE reports Tangen calling AI "the most important thing happening in the world at the moment" at the annual parliamentary hearing, with all NBIM staff using AI tools and more than half using coding tools; it puts the trading-cost reduction at NOK5bn between 2020 and 2025, a different figure and window from the Norges Bank transcript
entries.title: IPE reports widespread AI use and trading savings
bullets: Its NOK5bn saving over 2020–2025 differs in amount and period from the Norges Bank transcript; the figures are not interchangeable.

entries.source_note: Publishes 'From Experiment to Workflow': 83% ChatGPT Enterprise activation, 528 custom GPTs in first 90 days
entries.title: ChatGPT Enterprise activation reaches 83%
bullets: The fund reports 528 custom GPTs created within the first 90 days.

entries.source_note: Details agent-vs-human experiments (reconciliation, attribution, tariff scenario) and five-gate governance framework
entries.title: Agent experiments paired with five governance gates
bullets: Tests compare AI and humans on reconciliation, attribution and tariff scenarios under a defined approval framework.

entries.source_note: Launches ChatGIC, an enterprise secure ChatGPT, marking the start of broader AI adoption
entries.title: ChatGIC launches for internal use
bullets: The secure enterprise ChatGPT tool marks the start of broader adoption within GIC.

entries.source_note: GIC & Temasek staff detail AI in portfolio management at Fiduciary Investors Symposium; ChatGIC and RL research with Ortec Finance disclosed
entries.title: Portfolio teams discuss ChatGIC and reinforcement learning
bullets: Staff describe internal tools and research with Ortec Finance at the Fiduciary Investors Symposium.

entries.source_note: FY2024/25 report: AI in internal audit for anomaly detection; CEO calls AI integration a cross-organization priority
entries.title: Annual report names AI use in internal audit
bullets: Anomaly detection is a disclosed application; the CEO identifies wider integration as a priority.

entries.source_note: Head of Equities Trading Americas details production AI: broker-commentary LLM intelligence, semi-automated OTC RFQs, algo wheels, ECM deal processing, trader 'vibe coding'
entries.title: Trading team details production AI workflows
bullets: Applications include broker-commentary analysis, OTC requests, algo wheels, equity-deal processing and trader-built code.

entries.source_note: COO Rob Goldstein publicly announces Asimov, an agentic investment-research platform (hundreds of agents autonomously monitoring theses) built with the internal AI Labs team; helps ~150 fundamental-equity staff, scaling to other asset classes
entries.title: Asimov announced for investment research
bullets: The agent platform supports about 150 fundamental-equity staff, with expansion to other asset classes described.

entries.source_note: Rolls out RockAI no-code agent platform to 5,000 in-house developers; exec sponsor envisions AI as default mode with humans in oversight 'squads'
entries.title: RockAI rolls out to 5,000 developers
bullets: The no-code agent platform expands internal access; executives describe a future model with humans supervising AI teams.

entries.source_note: Temasek VP of AI Strategy details AI@Temasek program and internal workflow/decision use at Fiduciary Investors Symposium
entries.title: AI@Temasek program described publicly
bullets: The AI strategy team outlines internal workflow and decision-support applications at an investor symposium.

entries.source_note: CDO Mark Lim details internal AI: Winnow super-app, Knowledge Graph, 'AI & digital fluency' program; frames AI as bias-reduction and pitfall-spotting under human oversight
entries.title: Winnow and Knowledge Graph support internal decisions
bullets: Temasek describes these tools alongside staff training, emphasizing bias reduction and human oversight.

entries.source_note: Rolls out Client-Ready Article Summaries (GenAI market-perspective synopses) for advisors
entries.title: GenAI article summaries reach advisers
bullets: Client-Ready Article Summaries turns market commentary into short synopses for adviser use.

entries.source_note: CIO Lauren Wilkinson lays out assist→augment→action AI-maturity framework; places Vanguard at 'augment,' 'action' still ahead
entries.title: CIO places Vanguard at the augmentation stage
bullets: The firm’s assist–augment–action framework describes autonomous action as still ahead.

entries.source_note: Launches Expert Insights (GenAI portfolio analysis) in pilot with select advisors; firm-wide rollout planned later in 2026
entries.title: Expert Insights begins adviser pilot
bullets: Selected advisers test GenAI portfolio analysis; wider rollout is planned for later in 2026.

entries.source_note: AIA macro strategy goes live in late 2023, tested with real capital on a ~$100M sleeve of the flagship Pure Alpha fund
entries.title: AIA strategy starts trading live capital
bullets: The macro strategy is tested on an approximately $100M sleeve of Pure Alpha in late 2023.

entries.source_note: Standalone AIA fund begins trading with almost $2B from more than half a dozen clients, run primarily by machine learning and LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity); humans keep risk management, data acquisition and trade execution
entries.title: Standalone AIA fund starts with almost $2B
bullets: Machine learning and LLMs drive the strategy; humans retain risk management, data acquisition and trade execution.

entries.source_note: AIA Labs and Thinking Machines Lab publish a Qwen3-235B model fine-tuned via Tinker on expert-labeled investment documents: 84.7% accuracy vs 78.2% for the best frontier model tested (29.8% fewer errors) at 13.8x lower inference cost per task
entries.title: Fine-tuned model improves investment-document accuracy
bullets: AIA Labs and Thinking Machines report 84.7% accuracy versus 78.2%, at 13.8 times lower inference cost per task.

entries.source_note: Man Group researchers report generative-AI adoption above 70% of employees, with GitHub Copilot used for prototyping, ChatGPT being tested for document data extraction and hypothesis generation, and internal chatbots under development to comprehend Man's own code
entries.title: Researchers report GenAI adoption above 70%
bullets: Staff use Copilot for prototyping; document extraction, hypothesis generation and internal code chatbots are still being tested or developed.

entries.source_note: Man Numeric's agentic system AlphaGPT has produced several dozen investment signals approved for live trading; PM Ziang Fang: “I wouldn't call it autopilot, because we have a lot of checkpoints in place”
entries.title: AlphaGPT signals approved for live trading
bullets: Several dozen generated signals pass investment checks; portfolio managers emphasize continuing human checkpoints.

entries.source_note: Man Group details AlphaGPT's hypothesis-generation, implementation and evaluation pipeline: every AI-generated strategy entering live trading must pass the same Investment Committee thresholds as a human-generated one, under substantial human oversight
entries.title: AlphaGPT strategies face Investment Committee review
bullets: AI-generated strategies must meet the same live-trading thresholds as human-generated ones.

entries.source_note: Man Group announces a partnership with Anthropic, using Claude and the agentic coding tool Claude Code across its portfolio-management and technology teams globally
entries.title: Anthropic partnership extends Claude across teams
bullets: Man Group describes Claude and Claude Code use in portfolio management and technology globally.

entries.source_note: AQR launches two machine-learning-driven strategies, Turing Equities and Turing Macro, trading proprietary capital before opening to outside investors in 2025
entries.title: Turing strategies begin trading proprietary capital
bullets: Turing Equities and Turing Macro use machine learning before opening to outside investors in 2025.

entries.source_note: At the Bloomberg Invest conference, co-founder Cliff Asness says AQR lets machine-learning models drive more of its investment decisions: “we let the machine decide more… I'm reasonably convinced it's just at least a little bit better than us”
entries.title: Asness describes greater reliance on machine learning
bullets: He says models drive more investment decisions and judges their results somewhat better than human choices.

entries.source_note: Asness tells Bloomberg Television that AI now handles the combining and weighting of investment factors that guide AQR's stock picking, work he previously did himself: “AI's coming for me now… it's annoyingly better than me”
entries.title: AI takes on investment-factor weighting
bullets: Asness says models now combine and weight stock-selection factors he previously handled himself.

entries.source_note: Bloomberg reports machine learning now powers about a fifth of the trading signals in AQR's flagship multi-strategy fund, with ML also parsing unstructured text such as earnings-call transcripts and speeding up internal coding (company claim, as reported to Bloomberg)
entries.title: Machine learning supplies a fifth of flagship signals
bullets: Bloomberg reports AQR’s claim, alongside NLP analysis of earnings calls and faster internal coding.

entries.source_note: Forbes reports machine learning now recalibrates factor weights in real time and mines large datasets for signals across research and trading, with NLP aiding analyst research; AQR insiders describe AI as “evolutionary, not revolutionary,” with human input retained
entries.title: AI recalibrates factors while humans remain involved
bullets: Forbes describes real-time weighting, signal research and NLP; insiders characterize the change as evolutionary.

entries.source_note: Schroders Capital launches GAiiA (Generative AI Investment Analyst), an internal-only platform used by its private-equity team for due diligence and draft investment memos, with "continual and extensive human oversight and control"
entries.title: GAiiA launches for private-equity due diligence
bullets: The internal AI analyst drafts investment memos and supports diligence under continuing human oversight.

entries.source_note: Schroders discloses that First Cut, its custom GPT company-analysis tool, exceeds 80% adoption across investment desks and saves an average of 50 minutes per investor each day, and that ContextAI screens company reports against around 200 targeted sustainability questions (company claims)
entries.title: First Cut reports adoption above 80%
bullets: Schroders claims 50 minutes saved per investor daily; ContextAI also screens sustainability reports against about 200 questions.

entries.source_note: Google Cloud publishes how Schroders built a multi-agent equity-research assistant prototype on Vertex AI Agent Builder, with analysts reviewing every output for accuracy, relevance, completeness and conciseness
entries.title: Multi-agent equity research remains a prototype
bullets: Google Cloud describes a Vertex AI assistant whose outputs analysts review for accuracy, relevance and completeness.

entries.source_note: T. Rowe Price's Data Insights Group describes building a large language model solution to pull together internal and external research data so analysts and portfolio managers can query it, framed by the firm as "intelligent augmentation" rather than automation
entries.title: Research team builds an LLM query tool
bullets: The solution combines internal and external research for analysts and portfolio managers, framed as augmentation.

entries.source_note: Building internal data lake - WatersTechnology reports that a T. Rowe Price user can today drop data into a large language model that applies the firm's standards and ETL scripts to structure the metadata to about 80%, with a human finishing the rest, and that the team has stood up over 1,000 net-new data quality rules
entries.title: LLM helps structure internal data-lake metadata
bullets: WatersTechnology reports roughly 80% automated structuring with humans finishing the work, plus over 1,000 new data-quality rules.

entries.source_note: T. Rowe Price publishes its account of AI in the investing process: internal tools such as Investor Copilot, now Chat TRP, rolled out within months of the arrival of LLMs; predictive analytics and NLP applied to analyzing earnings calls; new "AI Adoption Specialist" roles introduced across Baltimore, London and Hong Kong; and a stated need for clear boundaries between full automation and human sign-off
entries.title: Chat TRP and adoption specialists support investors
bullets: The firm describes internal research tools, earnings-call analysis and regional adoption roles, with boundaries for human sign-off.

entries.source_note: T. Rowe Price announces an AI leadership model: a dedicated Investment AI Solutions organization under Vinit Agrawal covering AI strategy, agentic products, education and adoption; T. Rowe Price Labs under Mathieu Lorentz as the enterprise AI innovation hub within AI Engineering; and enterprise AI and model risk governance under Prabhakar Bhogaraju reporting to chief risk officer Ted Carter
entries.title: Dedicated investment AI and governance teams announced
bullets: New leadership covers investment AI solutions, enterprise experimentation, education and model-risk oversight.

entries.source_note: BAM ChatGPT, the firm's proprietary generative-AI assistant built to proactively push relevant information toward portfolio managers, is made available to employees
entries.title: BAM ChatGPT becomes available to employees
bullets: The proprietary assistant is designed to deliver relevant information to portfolio managers.

entries.source_note: Balyasny adds Peter Anderson, previously a Senior Research Scientist at Google, as a Senior AI Researcher on its applied artificial intelligence team led by Charlie Flanagan
entries.title: Applied AI team hires Peter Anderson
bullets: The former Google research scientist joins Charlie Flanagan’s team as a senior AI researcher.

entries.source_note: Balyasny publishes BAM Embeddings, a proprietary finance-domain retrieval model for RAG, reporting 60% accuracy retrieving the most relevant financial document passages against OpenAI's under 40%, and 55% vs 47% on FinanceBench
entries.title: BAM Embeddings reports stronger financial retrieval
bullets: Balyasny claims 60% retrieval accuracy versus OpenAI’s under 40%, and 55% versus 47% on FinanceBench.

entries.source_note: BAM's Applied AI team is featured in an OpenAI customer story; the firm sets out four principles behind its AI tools — model evaluation, feedback-driven design, firm-wide deployment, and implementation across investment teams — with Chief AI Officer Charlie Flanagan saying AI lets teams "apply first principles thinking faster, across more data, and with more structure"
entries.title: Applied AI team describes firm-wide implementation
bullets: An OpenAI customer story emphasizes model evaluation, employee feedback and deployment across investment teams.

entries.source_note: BAM holds its annual AI hackathon, bringing together employees from the U.S., EMEA and Asia across Businesses and Investing teams to work with the Applied AI team on automating complex tasks and improving daily processes
entries.title: Global AI hackathon targets daily workflows
bullets: Employees from investment and business teams work with Applied AI on task automation and process improvements.

entries.source_note: MacArthur establishes its first internal policy for the Use of Artificial Intelligence and shares it publicly on its own website; the policy creates the AI Tool Recommendation and Use Committee (AIRUC) to review and approve proposed uses of AI tools
entries.title: Internal AI policy establishes approval committee
bullets: MacArthur publishes its first AI-use policy and creates AIRUC to review proposed tools and applications.

entries.source_note: MacArthur publicly details its internal AI use in a Perspectives post by its VP of Communications and its Director of Technology in the Public Interest — naming staff use cases from SOP bottleneck analysis and data reformatting to archival review, pressure-testing chatbots and scenario-planning input, and reporting a staff survey in which most respondents saved time — and frames the past two years as "guardrails, pilots, and exploration" with "connecting governance and operations" still ahead
entries.title: Staff describe AI pilots and time savings
bullets: Examples span process analysis, data formatting and archival review; the foundation still frames adoption as guarded exploration.

entries.source_note: IPE reports that PGGM is using large language models in ESG, generative AI in forecasting to improve on quant models, and ChatGPT to improve coding
entries.title: PGGM reports LLM use in ESG and forecasting
bullets: The disclosed applications also include ChatGPT-assisted coding.

entries.source_note: PGGM's innovation director sets out the "AI Accelerator" programme and its adoption figures — over 70% of colleagues have worked with Microsoft Copilot, 20% use one or more of the 90-plus internal AI assistants, around 700 colleagues use the PGGM Intelligent Agent monthly, and customer contact centres apply speech-to-text with generative AI to summarise phone calls — while placing collaborative and autonomous AI in later phases
entries.title: AI Accelerator reports growing internal adoption
bullets: Over 70% have tried Copilot and about 700 use the internal agent monthly; autonomous collaboration remains a later phase.

entries.source_note: PGGM publishes how it governs AI in production: customer-service calls are transcribed and summarised by two AI models with quality control automated via an "LLM judge", MLflow serves as model registry for custom models, and the proof-of-concept phase for LLM trace monitoring closes "with first use cases" while EU AI Act-aligned governance integration remains a future objective
entries.title: Call summarization gains automated quality checks
bullets: PGGM describes an LLM judge and model registry; trace monitoring is emerging and wider governance integration remains planned.

entries.source_note: UiPath publishes a customer story on OMERS' Automation Centre of Excellence under the heading "AI-powered use cases: from tax compliance to financial insights", describing a robot that reviews a trial balance and checks T2 corporate income tax output against provincial regulations and 12 automated month-end and year-end processes, and quoting director Vipin Jain; OMERS is described as "exploring ways to embed AI with automation" via UiPath Autopilot
entries.title: UiPath describes tax and finance automation
bullets: The vendor cites twelve automated processes; OMERS is still exploring AI integration through Autopilot.

entries.source_note: OMERS Member Services Committee approves the Trusted AI Policy, effective 1 December 2024 — "developed to establish guidelines for the responsible development and use of AI"
entries.title: Trusted AI Policy receives committee approval
bullets: The responsible-development and use guidelines take effect on 1 December 2024.

entries.source_note: OMERS Administration Corporation Board approves a revised Trusted AI Policy effective 1 March 2025; the summary states the Q4 2024 policy established "the foundations of the AI Governance Program (the Program) at OMERS", to be matured by Data and Technology "in 2025 and beyond"
entries.title: Board revises Trusted AI Policy
bullets: The March update builds on the governance program established in late 2024, with further maturity planned.

entries.source_note: OMERS Administration Corporation Board approves a further updated Trusted AI Policy effective 23 May 2025, the third approval cycle in seven months
entries.title: Trusted AI Policy updated again
bullets: The board approves a third policy revision within seven months, effective immediately.

entries.source_note: At the Canadian Investment Review's 2026 Global Investment Conference, OMERS director of strategic technology, platform engineering, AI and advanced analytics Mo Mirza discloses an internally built AI platform now running up to 39 applications in production with more than 1,300 users and developers (company claim)
entries.title: Internal AI platform reaches 39 production applications
bullets: OMERS reports more than 1,300 users and developers; these are company figures presented at an investment conference.

entries.source_note: Microsoft publishes a customer story on BCI's Microsoft 365 Copilot and Azure OpenAI Service deployment: Copilot licences rotated from an initial 300 employees to "more than 570 users across the company, including the C-suite", with CTO Tony Payne reporting "over 22 solutions" saving "over 2,300 person-hours since the start of the automation program", a 30% reduction in audit-report writing effort, and an internal survey in which "84% of our respondents reported a 10%-20% productivity increase"
entries.title: Copilot access expands beyond 570 employees
bullets: A Microsoft customer story reports BCI’s productivity and audit-effort savings, based on company statements and a staff survey.

entries.source_note: BCI publishes CTO Tony Payne on AI in the investment process — AI agents integrated into portfolio data software, a natural language interface over a key infrastructure and renewable-resources dataset letting analysts "explore the data in real time", and investment teams building forecasting models, valuing the portfolio bottom-up and drafting deal alerts and investment memos; generative AI tools are "accessible to all of its global employees" and Payne says BCI has "taken AI out of the lab and put it in the hands of our investment professionals"
entries.title: Investment teams use AI agents and portfolio tools
bullets: BCI describes data queries, forecasting and memo drafting, with generative-AI tools accessible to all global employees.

entries.source_note: BCI reports that its Technology and Finance teams built and deployed an in-house AI platform automating "the full invoice lifecycle — from receipt through approval and reconciliation — using machine learning, computer vision, and natural language processing", tracing the program to an "inaugural Innovation Challenge in early 2024" and citing Info-Tech Research Group Innovator of the Year 2025 and CIO Awards Canada 2025
entries.title: In-house AI automates the invoice lifecycle
bullets: Technology and Finance deploy machine learning, computer vision and NLP from receipt through reconciliation.

entries.source_note: HOOPP publishes a Q&A with its Chief Technology Officer: AI is "infused in some of our systems and processes, such as robotic process automation and information security tools", Microsoft Copilot has been "recently launched" across HOOPP, and a "HOOPP AI Lab" has been launched "to explore advanced use cases for generative AI"
entries.title: Copilot and an AI lab launch at HOOPP
bullets: The CTO names existing automation and security uses, while the lab explores advanced generative-AI applications.

entries.source_note: HOOPP's 2024 annual-results release (published 2025-03-12) reports that during the year HOOPP "built out our Artificial Intelligence (AI) lab where we are testing potential use cases and challenges associated with this new technology", alongside "the creation of an internal investment Centralized Relationship Management (CRM) system"
entries.title: Annual results describe AI lab testing
bullets: HOOPP reports potential use cases and challenges under investigation; the disclosure does not establish broader production deployment.

entries.source_note: The Logic profiles Damien Steel, HOOPP's new Chief Technology, Data and AI Officer — the only Maple 8 top-level role with AI in the title: ~1,100 staff can choose ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot, an AI sandbox is live, and deal teams use AI for event-impact analysis, including a PM tool built with AI code generation to monitor the Iran war's impacts (company claims)
entries.title: Staff choose ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot
bullets: HOOPP describes access for about 1,100 employees, a live sandbox and investment event-analysis tools; these are company claims.

entries.source_note: NPS launches an "AI·혁신 추진단" (AI & Innovation Task Force) built from four divisions — pension/welfare, fund management (기금운용), institutional operations and systems — and states it will establish a top-level AI decision-making body and designate a Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
entries.title: AI and Innovation Task Force established
bullets: Four divisions participate, including fund management; a senior decision body and Chief AI Officer are planned.

entries.source_note: NPS reports it is the first Korean public institution to establish an AI technology cooperation framework with Kakao and to secure high-performance GPUs
entries.title: Kakao cooperation and GPU capacity announced
bullets: NPS reports a technology collaboration framework and access to high-performance computing infrastructure.

entries.source_note: NPS signed an agreement with LG AI Research to develop and test an AI-based foreign-exchange analysis service for fund management; the service is planned, not yet deployed
entries.title: Foreign-exchange AI service enters development agreement
bullets: NPS and LG AI Research plan development and testing; the service is not yet deployed.

entries.source_note: ATP becomes a founding partner of Denmark's AI Competence Pact, committing to upskill employees in generative AI, data ethics and automation, and states that "across all of our customer service and case processing, AI already plays a significant role today"
entries.title: ATP joins Denmark’s AI Competence Pact
bullets: It commits to staff training and says AI already plays a significant role in customer service and case processing.

entries.source_note: ATP reports that "Journalnotatsassistenten", a generative-AI call-summarization assistant, has been live for six months with about 300 customer advisors in the Pensions and Family Benefits divisions, is expanding to about 600, and is projected to free more than 16,000 staff hours a year
entries.title: Call-summary assistant serves about 300 advisers
bullets: ATP plans expansion to roughly 600 and projects over 16,000 staff hours saved annually; the saving is a forecast.

entries.institution: MassPRIM (Massachusetts Pension Reserves Investment Management Board)
entries.source_note: Chief Investment Officer reports PRIM's 2024 objectives include exploring "incorporating AI into PRIM's business processes and evaluate potential solutions" and examining "applications of large language models in investment analysts/monitoring processes", work staffers describe as "baby steps"
entries.title: Investment team sets exploratory AI objectives
bullets: PRIM plans to assess business-process and investment-monitoring applications, describing the work as “baby steps.”

entries.institution: MassPRIM (Massachusetts Pension Reserves Investment Management Board)
entries.source_note: Updates on "Aiperion," a consultant focus on next generation risk and asset allocation tool (not directly AI related)
entries.title: Aiperion risk-tool update provides adjacent context
bullets: The consultant’s risk and asset-allocation work is explicitly not directly AI-related.

entries.institution: MassPRIM (Massachusetts Pension Reserves Investment Management Board)
entries.source_note: Reporting on PRIM's annual board meeting, Chief Investment Officer states "Last year, PRIM began exploring uses for artificial intelligence" and that for 2025 "PRIM wants to continue to explore potential applications of AI in investment analysis and monitoring processes, as well as how AI can be used across the fund's business functions"
entries.title: PRIM continues exploring AI applications
bullets: The CIO describes ongoing investigation of investment analysis, monitoring and business functions; no deployment is named.

entries.source_note: Franklin Templeton announces a multi-year strategic partnership with Wand AI, stating it has spent the past year “evolving from pilot programs to production deployments of intelligent agents across multiple departments”, with “the initial implementation focused on priority use cases within the firm’s investment teams”
entries.title: Wand AI partnership follows agent production deployments
bullets: Franklin Templeton says agents have moved beyond pilots across departments, initially prioritizing investment teams.

entries.source_note: Franklin Templeton launches Intelligence Hub, “a modular, AI-driven distribution platform powered by Microsoft Azure”, to its U.S. Distribution teams after a multi-month pilot, calling it “a production-ready platform” that delivered “reduced daily preparation time and a significant increase in value-added client interactions”
entries.title: Intelligence Hub launches to US Distribution
bullets: The Azure-based platform follows a multi-month pilot and is described as production-ready, with improved preparation and client interactions.

entries.source_note: Names PM Copilot, an "Agentic Analyst", back-office reconciliation automation, and "rapid adoption of virtually every AI tool made available to employees"; also describes a client-facing goals-optimization product
entries.title: PM Copilot and Agentic Analyst named
bullets: The firm describes investment tools, reconciliation automation and rapid staff uptake, alongside a separate client-facing product.

entries.source_note: "Over 1,000 agents working on different investment teams"; "25% increase in the number of clients they're able to visit"; "11% uplift in sales"
entries.title: Firm reports over 1,000 investment-team agents
bullets: Reported business figures include 25% more client visits and an 11% sales uplift; these remain company claims.

entries.source_note: CEO Jenny Johnson driving AI adoption via AI hackathons, an "AI Champions" network, and mentioning "Rai," the company's new AI Operations agent
entries.title: AI champions and hackathons encourage adoption
bullets: CEO Jenny Johnson also names Rai, the firm’s AI Operations agent.

entries.source_note: EQT publishes “How exactly is EQT using AI?”, describing Motherbrain in active use across the deal management workflow, market analysis and monitoring of targets and competitors, talent sourcing, and pipeline and advisor tracking, with outputs surfaced for humans who retain decision authority
entries.title: Motherbrain supports deal management and research
bullets: EQT describes market monitoring, talent sourcing and pipeline tracking, with humans retaining decision authority.

entries.source_note: EQT publishes “Why private capital needs to embrace artificial intelligence”, stating “At EQT, AI is already embedded in much of our infrastructure”, naming “automated due diligence and modeling” and an AI-literacy roadmap for investment professionals, while disclosing that “a minority, 20 percent, of investment professional users represent the lion share of AI-connected prompts during Q1 2025”
entries.title: AI infrastructure use remains concentrated among staff
bullets: EQT names automated diligence and modeling, but says 20% of investment users generate most AI prompts.

entries.source_note: Amundi's Compliance Assistance tool — a GenAI tool built on ALTO Studio that analyses a document's compliance against a defined set of rules and assists marketing teams with the document analysis and correction process — wins “The Most Promising Project Using Gen AI” at the AM Tech Day Awards
entries.title: Compliance Assistance receives GenAI project award
bullets: The ALTO Studio tool helps marketing teams check documents against rules and make corrections.

entries.source_note: WatersTechnology reports that Alto Studio, Amundi's internal data platform giving teams of researchers, quants and financial analysts a safe way to use AI, “has 500 users at the buy-side firm” as Amundi Technology moves to commercialise it
entries.title: ALTO Studio reaches 500 internal users
bullets: WatersTechnology describes secure AI access for researchers, quants and analysts as Amundi moves toward commercialization.

entries.source_note: Amundi COO Guillaume Lesage states that all Amundi employees have access to ALTO Studio and about half use it weekly, citing “20 real applications to asset management” led by the compliance checker, with AI-based agents described as the development still to come
entries.title: About half of employees use ALTO Studio weekly
bullets: Amundi reports universal access and twenty applications; AI agents are described as a future development.

entries.source_note: Anthropic's financial-services agent launch quotes Citadel Head of Core Engineering Atte Lahtiranta saying analysts are using Claude for Excel to build and update coverage models, separate signal from noise, and pressure-test their work
entries.title: Analysts use Claude for Excel on coverage models
bullets: A vendor-published statement describes model building, updates and analytical checks by Citadel staff.

bullets: Ali-Milan Nekmouche leads a group tasked with implementation and collaboration across departments.

entries.title: New CIO appointment cites AI alpha generation
bullets: Two Sigma says Nekmouche helped expand machine-learning and AI investment signals.

entries.title: Scientists use LLMs to extract research features
bullets: The AI Core team describes analyzing Fed speeches and earnings calls against subsequent interest-rate moves.

entries.title: CTO expects all staff to use LLMs
bullets: Two Sigma claims AI compresses some insight-generation work from months into days.

entries.source_note: Microsoft's Hong Kong news centre reports CSOP's bespoke Azure OpenAI chatbot and email pre-classification system live for sales, senior management, HR and the operations middle office — boosting information-retrieval efficiency by 20% and filtering out 80% of non-essential correspondence (company claims); the Azure implementation began October 2023
entries.title: Azure chatbot and email classification go live
bullets: Microsoft reports CSOP’s claims of 20% better retrieval efficiency and filtering of 80% of non-essential correspondence.

entries.source_note: Microsoft customer story details CSOP's “Intelligence Hub” on Azure AI Foundry and GitHub Copilot, with three named production tools — an automated ETF reporting portal (10 minutes to 30 seconds), trade-data extraction from multi-format confirmations (60+ minutes to near-instant), and an analytics tool built by the Deputy CEO and CIO that reads stock charts and sell-side research to generate trading ideas for internal reference — and IT review as the pre-deployment governance gate
entries.title: Intelligence Hub delivers three production tools
bullets: Microsoft describes ETF reporting, trade-data extraction and research analytics, with IT review required before deployment.

entries.source_note: Global Head of Research Alexander Rudin and Head of Data and Analytics Minkyu Kim publish that “machine learning (ML) and AI have become integral to our investment process, supporting use cases from trading to forecasting”; an AI-powered chatbot is available to the investment teams and researchers “use it extensively as a research assistant”, and the Systematic Equity team “employs a suite of factors based on NLP” over earnings-call transcripts and regulatory filings — while generative AI is not used for direct investment modelling and an XGBoost fundamentals forecaster “has not been implemented in live portfolios”
entries.title: Investment teams use AI research and NLP factors
bullets: SSGA discloses a research chatbot and systematic signals; its XGBoost forecaster is not live and GenAI does not directly model investments.

entries.source_note: On State Street Corporation's Q1 2026 earnings call CFO John Woods says the firm has “built a centralized AI hub, which has a very deep use case pipeline that's beginning to scale” and that “This platform supports over 200 AI use cases now, with 70 of those already live”, with “Virtually every employee, where it makes sense” holding access and “all of our developers” on AI-assisted development tools; CEO Ron O'Hanley cites “deployment of our agentic platform and AI foundry to scale and accelerate AI”
entries.title: Parent company reports 70 live AI use cases
bullets: State Street Corporation describes a central hub supporting over 200 cases; this is group-level evidence, not an SSGA-only count.

entries.source_note: On the Q2 2026 earnings call Woods says State Street has “delivered agentic capabilities from a standardized copilot platform to all eligible employees” and is “embedding agentic capabilities within our operating model redesign” toward “a hybrid of human agentic team that actually staffs these integrated teams”; O'Hanley frames the year as “scaling AI adoption across the enterprise to improve execution, enhance productivity, and accelerate software development”
entries.title: Parent company expands agentic employee tools
bullets: State Street Corporation reports copilot access and operating-model redesign; the disclosure concerns the wider enterprise.

entries.source_note: Appoints Gideon Mann — previously head of machine learning product and research in Bloomberg's CTO office — as Global Head of AI, Technology, with responsibility for building out a new team to help the firm "navigate the AI space"
entries.title: Gideon Mann appointed Global Head of AI
bullets: The former Bloomberg machine-learning leader is tasked with building a new team.

entries.source_note: Global Head of AI Gideon Mann describes "our internally built search platform which provides employees the ability to search and interrogate proprietary content and lets developers integrate search functionality into own applications", and an AI function run as "both centralized and federated teams"
entries.title: Internal AI search platform described
bullets: Employees query proprietary content and developers integrate search into applications, supported by central and distributed teams.

entries.source_note: CIO Vlad Torgovnik announces a dedicated global AI lab — a separate environment, distinct from production systems, to accelerate experimentation with technologies "that may not be enterprise-ready", deepen collaboration with AI partners and attract AI experts — and says AI is "embedded in nearly everything we do"
entries.title: Global AI lab creates separate experimental environment
bullets: The lab is distinct from production systems and explores technologies that may not yet be enterprise-ready.

entries.source_note: Anthropic and Millennium announce they are co-developing a digital risk analyst that works under the supervision of Millennium's risk managers; Anthropic states Claude and Claude Code are already "used broadly across Millennium today", from trading desks and engineering to core business functions, including across many of the firm's 340+ investment teams, and that the tool logs its reasoning, tests its actions in sandboxed environments and requires human experts to evaluate and approve its decisions
entries.title: Digital risk analyst co-developed with Anthropic
bullets: Claude is described as broadly used; the new analyst operates under risk-manager supervision and human approval requirements.

entries.source_note: Chief Investment Officer reports that Fidelity's portfolio managers, sales and other staff use Saifr's natural-language processing to spot potential brand, reputational and regulatory risks in communications before they go to investor clients or the public, in real time as emails, presentations and speeches are created, and that Fidelity also checks materials for new funds it is launching with it
entries.title: Saifr screens communications for compliance risks
bullets: Fidelity staff use NLP on emails, presentations and fund materials before external publication.

entries.source_note: Early-stage internal discussion on application and governance.
entries.title: Internal AI application and governance discussions begin
bullets: The source note describes an early-stage discussion and supplies no named deployment.

entries.title: Text-to-SQL lets staff query internal databases
bullets: Fidelity showcases 93–95% execution accuracy and roughly 28-second responses at AWS re:Invent; the figures are reported performance.

entries.title: Quant team builds climate-risk pricing index
bullets: PGIM Quantitative Solutions uses NLP to assess physical climate risk in response to more extreme weather.

entries.title: Sales chatbot handles nearly 5,000 queries
bullets: Wholesalers retrieve fund information in seconds, under Prudential’s responsible-AI framework and human control of consequential decisions.

entries.title: Copilot and SuperApp support PNB employees
bullets: Microsoft describes staff rollout, prompt workshops and an Azure-based HR knowledge adviser inside Teams.

entries.title: Staff profile confirms continuing Copilot use
bullets: A PNB technology employee describes document drafting, slides, email and meeting summaries eight months after the rollout.

entries.title: Copilot expands from 300 to 600 staff
bullets: Microsoft reports M&G’s time-saving claims and PRAI code review, which flagged 3,500 issues over five months.

entries.source_note: WatersTechnology reports M&G Investments pursuing AI despite cost headwinds, including building a data lake “to ensure high-quality data is being fed into models”
entries.title: Data lake supports M&G’s AI development
bullets: WatersTechnology describes investment in higher-quality model inputs despite cost pressures.

entries.title: Equity research moves to Bloomberg’s AI platform
bullets: M&G replaces its research system with access to an engine containing more than 400 million company documents.

entries.title: Fine-tuning reportedly lifts model accuracy to 95%
bullets: AllianceBernstein describes improved generative-AI reliability through efforts to reduce hallucinations.

bullets: The operating-committee role covers AI use in investment research, operations and corporate functions.

entries.title: CAIO role positioned around workflow redesign
bullets: Chin reports to the COO and describes reimagining work across the firm rather than placing AI solely under technology.

entries.source_note: Discussion on a framework to build AI strategy and governance framework
entries.title: AI strategy and governance framework discussed
bullets: The source note records framework development without naming a new deployment.

entries.title: Internal AI agent analyzes quarterly earnings
bullets: The spotlight identifies earnings-report analysis as a specific internal application.

entries.title: Ares actively deploys about 25 AI use cases
bullets: The CEO names NDA review, compliance and investment memos across offices, with desktop tools being rolled out systematically.

entries.title: AI tools support legal and repeatable workflows
bullets: Ares describes document comparison, RFPs, due-diligence questionnaires and AML/KYC automation on its earnings call.

entries.title: Research companion project targets investment teams
bullets: The Edinburgh partnership plans an alpha test in 2025 and prototype in 2026 under an existing governance framework.

entries.source_note: Half-year 2026 results announcement: AI "is emerging as a meaningful enabler of growth and efficiency across the Group", Copilot is being rolled out across the business with "strong adoption to date", and AI capabilities will continue to be focused on "leading customer outcomes, increased productivity and long-term value creation"
entries.title: Half-year results describe ongoing Copilot rollout
bullets: Aberdeen reports strong uptake and potential efficiency benefits, without disclosing a penetration figure.

entries.title: CEO reports time savings from Copilot Premium
bullets: The business-wide rollout continues; AI becoming core to operations is described as an ambition.

entries.title: Fifty colleagues enter AI training program
bullets: The thirteen-month Multiverse course covers strategy and automation; the announcement names no deployed internal AI tool.

entries.title: Retail contact-center rebuild adds Copilot
bullets: The Microsoft collaboration covers transcription and case summaries for retail services; it does not establish investment-team adoption.

entries.title: Microsoft agreement extends Copilot rollout
bullets: L&G plans access for all 10,000 employees and reports AI supporting customer service at group level.

entries.title: Retail AI desktop reports efficiency improvements
bullets: The CEO describes early engagement with AI nudges; the call discloses no asset-management investment-process use.

entries.title: Ameriprise outlines AI and automation investments
bullets: The CEO cites adviser insights, asset-management transformation and service efficiency without quantifying adoption.

entries.title: eMeeting integrated into adviser workflows
bullets: Ameriprise describes productivity benefits where advisers have enabled the tool, within its existing data and governance platform.

entries.title: About 6,000 advisers reportedly use AI tools
bullets: The CEO claims substantial weekly time savings across meeting automation, summaries and Copilot Premium; figures are company estimates.

entries.title: Cloud migration frees resources for AI
bullets: DWS says moving applications into Deutsche Bank’s environment creates capacity for automation and AI work.

entries.source_note: On the Q1 2026 call CEO Stefan Hoops says DWS is only now ready to apply AI to investment management — "challenging PMs, not just summarizing what the Fed said yesterday" — after years spent getting data and processes in order; CFO Kobler cites "a range of initiatives focused on automation, artificial intelligence, and process simplification"
entries.title: Investment AI readiness follows data preparation
bullets: Management describes readiness and initiatives after years of process work; no named production tool is disclosed.

entries.source_note: I fetched three consecutive official quarterly calls in full. Q4 2025 (published 2026-02-05) and Q1 2026 (published 2026-05-07) contain ZERO occurrences of AI, artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, agents, automation, or any named internal tool — I asked for verbatim extraction on both and both came back empty. Only Q2 2026 carries the single AI sentence. Three quarters of a listed manager's own disclosure with almost nothing in it is a real finding about where this firm is, not a hole in my research
entries.title: Quarterly-call review finds sparse AI disclosure
bullets: The source note reports no AI mentions in two calls and one sentence in Q2; it supplies no internal deployment evidence.

bullets: Molly Weiss joins the Executive Committee with oversight of technology, AI, data and analytics.

entries.title: CEO names AI as a spending priority
bullets: Victory Capital discloses investment intent without a named tool, internal use case or adoption figure.

entries.title: SpectrumGPT tested with equity portfolio managers
bullets: The internal GPT-4 tool drafts research from unstructured data; managers retain decision-making authority.

entries.title: Moneyball pilot targets portfolio-manager behavioral bias
bullets: The developing Spectrum application compares current decisions with forty years of historical data.

entries.title: Proxy IQ replaces external US voting advisers
bullets: JPMAM announces reliance on its internal AI platform after ending ties with ISS and Glass Lewis for US voting.

entries.title: Proxy IQ’s research responsibilities clarified
bullets: IPE describes data collection, analysis and recommendations, with JPMAM retaining its stewardship standards.

entries.title: Samantha supports research and due diligence
bullets: TPG describes its internal agent platform and a proposed weekly committee report, while humans retain investment decisions.

entries.title: Daily internal LLM use approaches 80%
bullets: The CEO reports systematic rollout of customized tools; the adoption figure is a company claim.

entries.title: AI Research Assistant reaches 65% of investment staff
bullets: Manulife claims 70–80% less document-mining time in public markets; portfolio managers retain investment decisions.

entries.title: Three more AI tools enter live workflows
bullets: Manulife names compliance Q&A, retirement adviser outreach and retail sales tools, building on its research assistant.

bullets: The report describes use by more than two-thirds of investment personnel, with human decision-making retained.

entries.title: Annual report claims broader AI use
bullets: Liontrust describes investment, operations and reporting applications under formal governance, but gives no tool names or adoption figures.

entries.title: Quantitative research team reaches about 100 experts
bullets: ADIA describes AI and data-science capabilities supporting scientifically reviewed strategies and wider investment analytics.

entries.source_note: 2024 Review: roles in "artificial intelligence, machine learning and systematic investing" account for more than half of ADIA's new hires across investment and support functions; QRD grows to more than 125 professionals, introduces new systematic market-neutral and directional strategies, and advances work to unify its data platform and enhance its engineering infrastructure
entries.title: AI and systematic roles dominate new hiring
bullets: ADIA reports a research team above 125 professionals, new systematic strategies and expanded data infrastructure.

entries.source_note: ADIA reports a 125+ person QRD team, AI/ML-focused hiring and new systematic investment strategies, while expanding its data platform and engineering infrastructure.
entries.title: Annual review describes expanded quantitative capabilities
bullets: ADIA names a 125-plus research team, AI/ML hiring and new strategies, alongside platform investment.

entries.source_note: Investcorp Strategic Capital Group (ISCG, $1.5B AUM) announces a partnership with DiligentIQ, a generative-AI platform for private-markets due diligence; Investment Partner Tim Osnabrug says ISCG are "early adopters of the DiligentIQ platform" and "have seen firsthand the transformative power of AI in our operations"
entries.title: Strategic Capital Group adopts DiligentIQ
bullets: The private-markets due-diligence partnership cites early internal use and benefits, based on Investcorp’s statement.

entries.source_note: Addition on AI Investment Framework - autonomous research agents; origination tools; reporting assistants; operational automation.
entries.title: AI framework names research and operational applications
bullets: The note lists autonomous research agents, origination tools, reporting assistants and workflow automation.

entries.source_note: Investcorp launches an AI Investment Framework used across its Private Equity, Real Assets and Credit activities; Vice Chairman and CIO Rishi Kapoor says "At Investcorp, we are embedding AI across our investment platform, from sourcing and diligence through to portfolio management and value creation", and the report "explores how AI is being applied in practice, both within Investcorp's own operations and across its portfolio companies"
entries.title: AI Investment Framework spans three investment businesses
bullets: Investcorp describes sourcing, diligence and portfolio applications across private equity, real assets and credit, including portfolio-company uses.

entries.source_note: Appoints Shen Xu, previously Head of Natural Language Processing at Balyasny, as Head of Artificial Intelligence in San Francisco, with a brief to enhance the firm's data science platform and make its AI infrastructure "world class"
entries.title: Shen Xu appointed Head of Artificial Intelligence
bullets: The former Balyasny NLP leader is tasked with improving ExodusPoint’s data-science platform and AI infrastructure.

entries.source_note: Appoints Sridhar Nimmagadda, previously Head of Generative AI Technology at Point72, as Head of AI Transformation, expected to spearhead initiatives that use AI to improve research, trading efficiency and internal processes
entries.title: New AI Transformation head targets research and trading
bullets: Sridhar Nimmagadda joins from Point72 to lead planned improvements across investment and internal processes.

entries.source_note: Publishes "Navigating the Challenges of a Rapidly Evolving Landscape", describing AI integrated into "our data pipelines, research workflows, and back-testing systems", legal, compliance and technology teams pre-approving leading AI providers so new models can be deployed without delay, and each AI agent operating in its own contained environment with least-privilege access
entries.title: AI tools integrated into research infrastructure
bullets: Lynx describes data pipelines, back-testing and pre-approved providers, with isolated agent environments and limited access rights.

entries.source_note: "AI in Research | Part One: AI-Assisted Research" states Lynx began serious development of the workflow in early 2025 and that the research department has built a centralized knowledge base over thousands of sources with an automated ingestion pipeline; researchers use multiple AI agents in parallel, "tasks that previously required days can now often be completed in hours", and AI is "central to how we conduct research" (company claim)
entries.title: Research department uses parallel AI agents
bullets: Lynx reports a shared knowledge base and faster research, claiming some tasks now take hours instead of days.

entries.source_note: "AI in Research | Part Two: From Collaboration to Autonomy" sets out current work building an agentic research architecture — research, planning, coding and evaluation agents producing documented candidate strategies that "can be inspected, challenged, refined, or discarded by human researchers" — while noting "what we describe here reflects where we are now. It is not a fixed blueprint"
entries.title: Agentic research architecture remains under development
bullets: Agents generate candidate strategies that humans can inspect, challenge or reject; Lynx presents the design as evolving.

entries.source_note: Nikkei reports SMDAM is introducing generative AI into its investment operations across about 20 uses including analysis of investee companies, expecting to cut about 14 hours of work per person per month, built on three generative-AI services provided by Microsoft and others and using AI agents that judge and carry out tasks themselves
entries.title: AI rollout targets roughly twenty investment applications
bullets: Nikkei reports planned generative-AI uses and expected savings of fourteen hours per person monthly.

entries.source_note: Own release: full-scale business use of the in-house-developed AI support tool "Assistant For Investment Research (AIR)" begins in the investment division — the macro research group for macro-news gathering and internal summarisation, the credit bond group for market analysis and issue evaluation — drawing on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud AI models over secure internal networks, with about 50,000 hours a year of efficiency projected in the investment division alone and company-wide rollout still in development (company claim)
entries.title: AIR begins full-scale use in investment division
bullets: SMDAM names macro and credit applications; projected annual savings and company-wide expansion remain forward-looking.

entries.source_note: Nikkei reports SMDAM is having AI read in its investment teams' past investment decisions and thinking processes so that AI can take part in the discussion when analysing companies
entries.title: AI learns from past investment discussions
bullets: Nikkei describes using teams’ decision histories to support company-analysis conversations.

entries.source_note: Own release: SMDAM says it is advancing the use of AI in investment-trust agreement (約款) management jointly with neoAI, to raise the sophistication and efficiency of that work — stated in progressive terms rather than as a completed deployment
entries.title: AI agreement-management work advances with neoAI
bullets: SMDAM describes development in progress rather than a completed deployment.

entries.source_note: Own release: Daiwa AM and LegalOn Technologies begin joint development of a ドキュメント審査AIシステム (document-review AI) targeting the 月次レポート monthly fund reports, aimed at the accuracy, speed and knowledge reuse of review work, with introduction into 広告審査業務 (advertising review) planned for October 2025 and expansion to further documents and to business areas beyond advertising review stated as future scope — LegalOn's first joint development in the financial field
entries.title: Document-review AI enters joint development
bullets: Daiwa and LegalOn target monthly fund reports, with advertising-review introduction planned for October 2025.

entries.source_note: Own release: a second joint development with LegalOn — an インサイダー情報検知AIシステム that screens records of analysts' interviews with listed companies for information that could constitute a 重要事実 under Article 166(2) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act before it is shared internally, with 実務導入 planned for April 2026; the same release states the earlier document-review AI has been in place at the firm 「10月より」 (since October)
entries.title: Insider-information screening tool announced
bullets: April deployment is planned for interview-record screening; the earlier document-review system is confirmed live since October.

entries.source_note: Nikkei reports the insider-detection system: AI identifies material non-public information by reference to national guidelines, preventing pre-disclosure facts such as large earnings revisions or capital and business alliances from circulating internally; the 法務コンプライアンス部 previously checked by eye and the burden had grown as Tokyo Stock Exchange policy increased investor–issuer dialogue, with Daiwa AM to put it to business use from April (「4月の実用化を目指す」)
entries.title: Compliance team plans AI screening for material information
bullets: Nikkei describes an April target for detecting non-public facts before analyst interview notes circulate internally.

entries.source_note: ドキュメント審査AIシステム developed from July 2025 and 「10月より当社にて導入しております」; insider-detection system screens analyst interview records for 重要事実 (FIEA Art. 166(2)) before internal circulation, 「2026年4月の実務導入を予定」, voice-data extension flagged — no user count, policy or committee.
entries.title: Document-review deployment confirmed; insider screening planned
bullets: Daiwa reports October adoption of document-review AI, while the insider-detection system targets April 2026 use.

entries.source_note: Nissay Asset Management builds an integrated-report analysis platform where humans and AI collaborate. Using generative AI, analysis productivity improved 3–5×.
entries.title: Integrated-report analysis reports three-to-fivefold productivity
bullets: Nissay describes a platform combining human review with generative AI.

entries.source_note: Own release: develops and internally releases generative-AI applications built from an employee ideathon (370 cumulative participants, 23 practical ideas), naming チャット, ESGインタビューアシスト and NAVIS検索システム, on a company-dedicated generative-AI execution environment using Azure OpenAI and Amazon Bedrock to reference internal information
entries.title: Three generative-AI applications released internally
bullets: Staff ideas lead to chat, ESG interview assistance and NAVIS search on a dedicated environment using Azure OpenAI and Bedrock.

entries.source_note: Nikkei interview with president 大関洋: Nissay AM moved early on AI in its operations and 「今は社員の7割が活用する」 — 70% of employees now use it
entries.title: President reports AI use by 70% of staff
bullets: The Nikkei interview supplies an employee adoption figure, stated by Nissay’s president.

entries.source_note: Own release: generative-AI platform NAM-GPT wins Celent's Model Buyside Award 2025 (Digital Transformation and Generative AI Application category), cited for early adoption, evangelists placed in every department alongside management, and major efficiency and productivity gains in ESG information collection and evaluation tasks
entries.title: NAM-GPT receives digital-transformation award
bullets: Nissay cites departmental evangelists and improved ESG information collection and evaluation, based on company claims.

entries.source_note: Nikkei: 「ニッセイアセットマネジメントは企業の温暖化ガス削減目標などをAIが調査する」 — AI investigates investee companies' greenhouse-gas reduction targets, part of major managers moving generative AI into the investment process
entries.title: AI researches investee emissions-reduction targets
bullets: Nikkei identifies a concrete sustainability-analysis application within the investment process.

entries.source_note: Own release: co-produces the cross-industry generative-AI training package 「AIユースケーススタディ for アセマネ」 with 東京海上アセット, 農林中金全共連アセット and SOMPOアセット, pooling 「自社の生成AI活用に関する知見」 into courses spanning sales, operations, trading, middle/back office and corporate functions
entries.title: Managers pool internal experience into GenAI training
bullets: Nissay and three peers produce courses spanning investment operations, sales and corporate functions.

entries.source_note: 证券时报网 reports EFundGPT is already in real use — published pieces carry the tag 「以上内容由EFundGPT生成」 (the above content was generated by EFundGPT) — and that E Fund has filed trademark applications for 「EFundGPT」 and 「易识观澜」
entries.title: EFundGPT appears in published content
bullets: Securities Times reports content explicitly attributed to the tool, alongside trademark applications.

entries.source_note: People's Bank of China 2023 Financial Technology Development Awards: E Fund takes a first prize for 「基于人工智能的一站式主动权益投研业务平台」 (AI-based one-stop active-equity investment research platform) and a second prize for the EFundGPT asset-management large-model platform and its scenario applications
entries.title: AI research platform and EFundGPT win awards
bullets: The central bank’s technology awards recognize active-equity research infrastructure and the large-model platform.

entries.source_note: E Fund completes private deployment of the full-parameter DeepSeek model on internal infrastructure, and reports EFundGPT 「应用落地」 across research support, copy generation, coding, daily meeting minutes, data queries and intelligent trading
entries.title: DeepSeek deployed privately alongside EFundGPT applications
bullets: E Fund reports research, coding, meeting notes, data queries and trading-related uses on internal infrastructure.

entries.source_note: Upgraded with DeepSeek's synthetic-data and knowledge-distillation techniques, EFundGPT is reported to 「可以覆盖70%以上业务部门的人工智能应用生态」 (able to cover the AI application ecosystem of 70%+ of business departments), alongside an AI 「宏观研究员」 (macro researcher) credited with improving macro research efficiency and accuracy (company claim)
entries.title: EFundGPT claims coverage across over 70% of departments
bullets: The statement describes potential application coverage and a macro-research assistant; it is not an employee usage rate.

entries.source_note: E Fund says it launched EWork, an enterprise-grade AI infrastructure platform, 「推动AI能力在投研全场景规模化应用」 — to drive scaled application of AI capability across all investment-research scenarios
entries.title: EWork launches as enterprise AI infrastructure
bullets: E Fund describes a platform intended to scale AI applications throughout investment research.

entries.source_note: As reported September 6, 2026: EWork skills and governance across business lines reported; the underlying rollout date is not established
entries.title: EWork skills and governance reported across business lines
bullets: September 6 is the report date; the underlying rollout date is not established.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 reports, 据中欧基金介绍, that the firm 「应用BERT和Siamese网络、OCR等人工智能技术建设了一套成熟、完整的『智能交易对手管理系统』」 for trade risk control, and has 「引入智能IVR系统」 using speech recognition, NLP and machine learning to handle client queries automatically around the clock (company claims)
entries.title: AI systems support counterparty risk and client queries
bullets: China Europe describes BERT, Siamese networks and OCR for trading controls, plus automated voice-response service; claims are company-supplied.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 reports 中欧基金 「近期完成了DeepSeek系列开源模型的私有化部署」, with use 「未来将根据效果运用到办公、投资研究、客户服务等领域」 — the deployment is completed, the application stated in the future tense
entries.title: Private DeepSeek deployment completed
bullets: Office, research and customer-service applications are described as future uses subject to evaluation.

entries.source_note: 证券时报网 quotes 中欧基金权益专户投委会主席 王培: 「AI内嵌式对投研业务的赋能，会在三年后给我们带来实质性的变化」, calling it 「不是短期的技术噱头，而是确定性极强的长期趋势，将重塑整个投研链条」 — a named long-term priority, with the substantive change dated three years out
entries.title: Investment leader frames AI as a long-term priority
bullets: The quoted outlook puts substantive research-process change three years ahead rather than claiming current deployment.

entries.source_note: AI不具备基于事实和数据给出正确判断的能力，一旦透露出一点点倾向性，它就容易跟着你走
entries.title: Commentary warns about AI judgment and suggestibility
bullets: The note cautions that AI may follow a user’s preferred answer; it does not identify an internal tool or rollout.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 reports 中欧基金's 「最新开发的投研Agent已集成超过100个Skills」 covering data scraping, industry analysis, financial modelling and report writing, with 「研究员信息检索效率提升60%以上」 and the equity team's 「五要素模型」 having 「实现智能化升级」; 量化投决会主席曲径 says large language models markedly raised code-writing and IT development efficiency
entries.title: Research agent integrates more than 100 skills
bullets: China Europe claims coverage from retrieval to modeling and report writing, with information-retrieval efficiency improved by over 60%.

entries.source_note: As reported September 6, 2026: Deployed sector-outlook agent with >250-subsector coverage reported; the underlying rollout date is not established
entries.title: Sector-outlook agent reportedly covers over 250 subsectors
bullets: The deployment is reported on September 6; its original rollout date is not established.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 reports that 招商基金信息技术部 「展望了未来AI在资管行业有可能出现的应用场景：一是智能投顾；二是量化投资」 — the IT department setting out prospective, future-tense AI scenarios for asset management, with no internal deployment claimed
entries.title: IT team outlines prospective AI applications
bullets: China Merchants names future advisory and quantitative-investment scenarios without claiming internal deployment.

entries.source_note: 21世纪经济报道 names 招商基金 among 近20家 large and mid-size public fund managers that 「已完成DeepSeek系列开源模型私有化部署」, reporting the firm 「完成系列开源模型的本地化部署，并在内部场景中验证其效率和表现优势」 and that its technology team 「新增部署R1量化版本，相对于全参数版本降低部分算力成本」
entries.title: DeepSeek models deployed and tested internally
bullets: The technology team validates applications and adds a quantized R1 model to reduce computing costs.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 reports, 据招商基金介绍, that the firm 「已落地多项AI应用，访谈纪要日均产出约30篇，财报点评覆盖31个行业」, has repositioned its technology mandate from 「保障业务运行」 to 「嵌入经营决策、服务客户体验、守住风险底线」 with the 投研系统 as 「公司数字化转型的核心生产平台」, and 「已构建事前预警、事中监控和事后分析的多层防线，上线60余个自研风控维度池」 under a rule that 「合规风控规则优先于模型判断」
entries.title: AI produces interview summaries and earnings commentary
bullets: China Merchants reports about thirty summaries daily and coverage of 31 industries, with compliance rules taking priority over model judgment.

entries.source_note: 21世纪经济报道 reports that 国泰基金 「于2025年1月底完成了DeepSeek系列模型私有化部署，搭建了国泰基金AI应用开发平台，在品牌持营、风险管控、产品运营、文档办公等业务场景中有了不错表现」 — private deployment of the DeepSeek model family completed at end-January 2025 and an in-house AI application development platform built, live across brand marketing, risk control, product operations and document/office work; the same article names 国泰基金 among 近20家 large and mid-size public fund managers that 「已完成DeepSeek系列开源模型私有化部署」
entries.title: Private DeepSeek platform supports business workflows
bullets: Guotai reports applications in marketing, risk, product operations and office work after completing deployment in January.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 reports that 国泰基金 「已建成『数据基座—知识基座—Agent能力层』三层递进的智能投研架构，底层是覆盖A股、基金等核心维度的结构化数据体系，中间层是涵盖研报、路演纪要等在内的非结构化知识库，支持语义级检索」 — a completed three-tier investment-research architecture combining a structured data base, an unstructured knowledge base with semantic retrieval, and an Agent capability layer
entries.title: Three-layer AI research architecture completed
bullets: Guotai combines structured data, a searchable research knowledge base and agent capabilities.

entries.source_note: As reported September 6, 2026: Autonomous research agent deployed, with rule-engine safeguards reported; the underlying rollout date is not established
entries.title: Autonomous research agent reported with safeguards
bullets: The note names rule-engine controls; September 6 is the report date, not an established rollout date.

entries.source_note: 汇添富基金 becomes one of the first ecosystem partners for Baidu's 文心一言 (ERNIE Bot), 「积极探索大语言模型在基础问题解答、客户需求识别、内部效率提升等方面的应用」 — actively exploring large-language-model use for basic question answering, client-need identification and internal efficiency (firm's own account, published 2025-02-07)
entries.title: ERNIE partnership begins exploratory LLM work
bullets: China Universal investigates question answering, client needs and internal efficiency, according to its later account.

entries.source_note: 汇添富基金 announces it has completed private deployment of the DeepSeek open-source model family, stating the models 「将应用于投资研究、产品销售、风控合规、客户服务等核心业务场景」 (will be applied to investment research, product sales, risk/compliance and client service) while 「公司内部也正针对多个业务场景进行大模型应用的测试验证工作…为后续的大规模推广和应用奠定坚实基础」 (internal testing and validation still under way to lay the groundwork for a later large-scale rollout); an AI team codenamed 「deepfund」 is formed in the internet-finance department for fund e-commerce
entries.title: DeepSeek deployment precedes wider application testing
bullets: The models are installed privately, but business validation continues and large-scale rollout remains a future step.

entries.source_note: 21世纪经济报道 reports that 汇添富基金 「今年春节后完成了DeepSeek系列开源模型的私有化部署，目前已应用于信息萃取、代码助手、通用问答等多个内部业务场景」, with 「债券台账解析场景中，系统已实现对相关台账记录的全量智能解析，识别准确率达96%以上」, 77% accuracy 「在存单报价解析场景中」, and a code assistant that 「近一个月内…累计生成代码推荐超过5万次，采纳率由原来的3%提升至10%」 — the firm is named among 近20家 public fund managers that had completed private DeepSeek deployment
entries.title: DeepSeek supports data extraction and coding
bullets: China Universal reports over 96% bond-ledger parsing accuracy and code-suggestion acceptance rising from 3% to 10%.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 reports, 据永赢基金介绍, that the firm 「已经完成了初步的私有化部署」 of the DeepSeek open-source model family 「并成功将其应用于制度解答、聊天记录整理、非结构化数据核对和代码开发等多个领域」 — a preliminary private deployment in production across policy Q&A, chat-log organisation, unstructured data reconciliation and code development
entries.title: Preliminary DeepSeek deployment supports four internal tasks
bullets: Maxwealth names policy Q&A, chat-log organization, unstructured-data reconciliation and code development.

entries.source_note: 21世纪经济报道 reports that 永赢基金 「主要通过Deepseek开展了问答、制度检索和非结构化交易数据整理的场景，同时还在测试文档优化、AI文档助手、智能知识库、投研数据整理、内部数据分析查询等多种应用场景」 — three scenarios launched, five more including investment-research data work still under test
entries.title: Three DeepSeek applications live; five more in testing
bullets: Maxwealth describes question answering, policy retrieval and trade-data organization, with research-data uses still being evaluated.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报's industry AI roundup reports that 「永赢基金同样将投研系统建设视为数字化转型的重要战略内容」 and that 永赢 is among firms whose 「投研系统投入逐年增加」, naming 天玑权益研究系统 for macro-to-company research data and content management and 牵星固收投研系统 as 「利用大数据技术和智能评级模型」, with its self-developed research, risk and trading systems 「均与恒生O32系统实时联通」 — no 大模型 or 生成式 application named 18 months after the DeepSeek deployment
entries.title: Research platforms expand without new GenAI detail
bullets: Maxwealth names equity and fixed-income systems with intelligent rating models; the account identifies no large-model application.

entries.source_note: As reported September 6, 2026: Investment research, risk and agent-platform use reported; the underlying rollout date is not established
entries.title: Research, risk and agent-platform use reported
bullets: September 6 is the publication date; the underlying rollout timing is not established.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 reports CEO 李一梅's keynote setting out AI adoption across 投研 (investment research), 服务 (client service) and 运营 (operations), and naming the 「华夏飞翼固收一体化智能平台」, which 「大幅提升了组合分析、交易执行的效率，优化了资产配置逻辑，还能沉淀优质的投研成果」 — substantially improved portfolio-analysis and trade-execution efficiency and optimised asset-allocation logic (company claim; no metric given)
entries.title: Feiyi platform supports fixed-income workflows
bullets: ChinaAMC claims better portfolio analysis and trade execution, but supplies no efficiency metric.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 interviews deputy general manager and CIO 阳琨: 「过去三年，华夏基金持续加大AI投研赋能投入，搭建主动投研『灵犀系统』、固定收益投研『飞翼系统』等智能体系，全面覆盖投前决策、投中辅助、投后分析全流程，实现投研成果标准化沉淀、投研流程可复制、交易执行可预判」 — two named intelligent systems built over three years covering the full pre-trade, in-trade and post-trade research workflow
entries.title: Lingxi and Feiyi cover the research lifecycle
bullets: ChinaAMC describes three years of system development spanning pre-trade decisions, trading support and post-trade analysis.

entries.source_note: 证券时报 reports ChinaAMC 「率先建立了主动、动态的威胁感知与防御体系，完成了全公司数据资产的分级分类，建立了差异化防护体系」 — proactive dynamic threat detection built and firm-wide data-asset grading and classification completed — while the AI-fused 「安全大脑」 remains 「打造」 (under construction); the same report states the firm 「清晰界定『AI可替代』与『人力必须亲为』的边界：把基础工作交给AI，但趋势判断、价值抉择、产业沟通必须由研究员躬身践行」
entries.title: Data safeguards expand; AI security system still developing
bullets: ChinaAMC reports completed data classification and clear boundaries reserving judgment and company engagement for researchers.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 reports that Harvest has completed knowledge-base construction across 100-plus secondary sub-industries including semiconductors, computing and innovative drugs, and uses knowledge-graph technology to convert unstructured data into investment leads covering over 5,000 listed companies, on a 「数据+模型+工具」 intelligent investment-research platform that moves the research process from 「经验驱动」 toward 「数据与经验共振」 (company claim)
entries.title: Knowledge platform covers over 5,000 listed companies
bullets: Harvest reports industry knowledge bases and graphs that turn unstructured information into investment leads.

entries.source_note: In 中国基金报's industry AI roundup Harvest says it has built investment-research digitalisation since 2018 and over the past two years has 「将AI能力深度落地投研业务」, dividing AI in investment research into production, interaction and decision stages with production and interaction 「已发挥巨大价值」 — and names 「能力边界、任务边界和责任边界」 as the key to public-fund AI build-out (company claims)
entries.title: Harvest describes AI within investment-research workflows
bullets: The firm claims benefits from production and interaction applications, emphasizing capability, task and responsibility boundaries.
