entries.source_note: As reported September 6, 2026: Enterprise AI assistant and four application areas launched, according to the firm; the underlying rollout date is not established
entries.title: Enterprise AI assistant and four application areas announced
bullets: Harvest reports the launch on September 6; the original rollout date is not established.

entries.source_note: After exploration and validation, the locally deployed models have reached a usable stage in internal data processing, code-assisted generation, text generation, enterprise-grade RAG and research-report parsing." Five named internal use cases.
entries.title: Local models reach usable stage in five applications
bullets: Fullgoal names data processing, coding, text generation, enterprise retrieval and research-report parsing after validation.

entries.source_note: 21世纪经济报道's census of nearly 30 large and mid-size public fund managers names Fullgoal among the roughly 20 that had completed private deployment of the DeepSeek open-source model series; Fullgoal itself says open-source models 「将」 play an increasingly key role in digital transformation, investment-strategy optimisation and risk-control build-out — future tense — and calls validating business-scenario AI deployment a prerequisite of AI exploration (company claims)
entries.title: Private DeepSeek deployment confirmed in industry census
bullets: Fullgoal’s broader transformation and risk-control ambitions remain future-facing and conditional on business validation.

entries.source_note: In 中国基金报's industry AI roundup Fullgoal sets out a 「数据—算法—算力」 three-in-one transformation mainline and positions its integrated investment-research intelligence platform as the core productivity base of digital transformation; it says its equity, fixed-income and quant business lines have all been fully self-developed and put into use, and describes a distributed-EDA compliance and risk engine covering pre-trade simulation, intraday alerts and post-trade supervision across all on- and off-exchange scenarios (company claims; the firm's paragraphs carry no AI or large-model vocabulary)
entries.title: Investment and risk platforms reported in use
bullets: Fullgoal describes self-developed systems across business lines, but its quoted passages contain no explicit AI or large-model claim.

entries.source_note: As reported September 6, 2026: >200 users and >3,000 daily requests reported by the firm; research workbench and anti-money-laundering agent described; the underlying rollout date is not established
entries.title: AI platform reports over 3,000 daily requests
bullets: Fullgoal cites more than 200 users, a research workbench and an AML agent; the underlying rollout date is unknown.

entries.source_note: Sets up an artificial-intelligence lab to track frontier large-model technology, in chairman 张东's later account: 「2022年ChatGPT发布后，博时基金于2023年成立人工智能实验室，系统布局大模型前沿技术，将AI广泛应用于投研、营销、风控、运营及研发等全业务环节」 — AI applied across investment research, marketing, risk control, operations and R&D (company claim; no application is named per function)
entries.title: AI lab established to develop large-model capabilities
bullets: Bosera’s later account claims use across business functions, without naming an application for each.

entries.source_note: Deploys DeepSeek-v1 on its own Huawei Ascend servers as the base model for the firm's intelligent development tooling — 21世纪经济报道 reports Bosera as one of the earliest public fund managers onto DeepSeek, having tested the model's code-writing and logical-reasoning ability from the start of 2024, and upgrading the deployment to DeepSeek-v2 in August 2024
entries.title: DeepSeek-v1 deployed on internal Huawei servers
bullets: Bosera tests coding and reasoning capabilities and upgrades to DeepSeek-v2 in August 2024.

entries.source_note: Completes internal deployment of DeepSeek-R1 at the start of 2025 and 「开始探索」 — begins exploring — its use in investment research, investment-advisory services and software development; a Bosera representative says R1's lower compute demand 「为进一步推广应用创造了条件」, creating the conditions for wider rollout (company claim, future-facing)
entries.title: DeepSeek-R1 deployment opens further exploration
bullets: Bosera begins investigating research, advisory and software applications; wider rollout remains an objective.

entries.source_note: 证券时报 quotes Bosera chief digital officer 车宏原: 「目前博时基金已有团队在公有云和合规的前提下使用OpenClaw，同时也在研究国产软件在内部安全合规的使用场景」 — teams are already using OpenClaw on public cloud under compliance conditions, with domestic software under internal security-and-compliance review; he frames such agents as giving research staff a 「超级数字助手」 and pushing the research system toward a 人机协同 (human-machine collaboration) structure
entries.title: Teams use OpenClaw under compliance conditions
bullets: Bosera describes public-cloud use and ongoing review of domestic tools for safe internal applications.

entries.source_note: Bosera's AI lab launches 「龙虾平台（内部命名BSBox）」, a self-developed enterprise intelligent-service platform, which 「正式落地投入规模化应用」 — formally goes live into scaled application — described by the firm as opening enterprise-grade AI agent deployment in the fund industry, handling personalised work tasks with 「分钟级全流程办结」, minute-level end-to-end completion (company claims; no user count, adoption rate or usage frequency disclosed)
entries.title: BSBox agent platform enters live use
bullets: Bosera claims scaled deployment and minute-level task completion, without publishing user counts or usage frequency.

entries.source_note: TIRD (天弘智能研究及决策系统), the firm's integrated investment-research and decision platform, goes live; 中国基金报 reports that after several key iterations it 「已成为天弘权益投研工业化的重要基座」 — has become the base layer of Tianhong's industrialised equity research — closing the loop from research task to traceable decision, with deputy general manager 聂挺进 calling it the firm's 「投研压舱石」
entries.title: TIRD investment-research platform goes live
bullets: Tianhong describes a traceable workflow from research tasks to decisions within equity investing.

entries.source_note: FinAgent system. Self-built financial LLM winning 2024年度金融科技发展奖
entries.title: FinAgent financial language model receives technology award
bullets: The source note identifies a self-built system and a 2024 financial-technology award, without adoption figures.

entries.source_note: Named in 21世纪经济报道's industry census among the ~20 large and mid-size public fund managers that 「已完成DeepSeek系列开源模型私有化部署」 — had completed private deployment of the DeepSeek open-source model series (list entry only; the census carries no Tianhong-specific paragraph)
entries.title: Industry census lists private DeepSeek deployment
bullets: Tianhong is named among deployed firms, but the article provides no firm-specific application detail.

entries.source_note: 21世纪经济报道 reports 「天弘基金量化投研体系已全面迭代至AI阶段，70%以上的超额因子来源于AI学习」 — the quantitative investment-research system fully iterated to an AI stage, with over 70% of excess-return factors sourced from AI learning — across 19 index-enhancement funds holding RMB 12.084B at end-Q3 2025, with over 75% of those factors replaced within a year (company claims)
entries.title: AI supplies over 70% of excess-return factors
bullets: Tianhong reports use across nineteen index-enhancement funds with RMB 12.084B at end-Q3 2025; figures are company claims.

entries.source_note: Named in 21世纪经济报道's industry census among the ~20 public fund managers that 「已完成DeepSeek系列开源模型私有化部署」 — had completed private deployment of the DeepSeek open-source model series (list entry only; the census carries no 平安基金-specific paragraph)
entries.title: Private DeepSeek deployment listed in industry census
bullets: Ping An is included among deployed managers, without a dedicated account of applications.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报 publishes 信息技术负责人 游自强's account of a 「一一四」 technology structure: the large-model platform 「AI青蚨」 live in 投研 with 「千人千面的Agent工具」 for 个股研究、行业研究、投顾分析, an 智能参会工具 generating meeting minutes without attendance, an 智能机器人 digesting WeChat groups 「每天定时」 by email, and an 「AI审核中台」 in compliance starting from 信息披露 (company claims)
entries.title: AI Qingfu supports investment-research agents
bullets: Ping An also names meeting summaries, scheduled chat digests and a compliance-review platform, based on its technology leader’s account.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报's roundup of 头部公募 AI programmes reports that 平安基金's 投研平台 「已逐步形成覆盖投前研究、投中支持、投后分析的一体化框架」, extended into 投资管理、研究管理、组合分析、风险绩效 subsystems, with 智能化应用 including 智能指令识别、智能会议、信息摘要
entries.title: Research platform integrates investment and risk workflows
bullets: Ping An describes intelligent instructions, meetings and information summaries within a broader investment-management framework.

entries.source_note: Named in 21世纪经济报道's census of nearly 30 large and mid-size public fund managers among the roughly 20 that 「已完成DeepSeek系列开源模型私有化部署」 — had completed private deployment of the DeepSeek open-source model series (list entry only; the census carries no Dacheng-specific paragraph)
entries.title: Dacheng listed among private DeepSeek deployments
bullets: The industry census provides no firm-specific paragraph or named application.

entries.source_note: In 中国基金报's roundup of 头部公募 AI programmes Dacheng is among the managers reporting 「投研系统投入逐年增加，不断加强功能的广度和深度」, and states that 「最大的技术突破点是企业级金融智能体」 — the enterprise-grade financial agent is the biggest technical breakthrough point — describing a 未来 architecture that would turn the whole investment-research process into 「自主协同、人机分工、投研知识资产沉淀、合规内嵌的完整数字生产线」; the firm's separately quoted 「投前合规校验、投中实时拦截、投后复盘追溯的全闭环管控模式」 carries no AI vocabulary (company claims)
entries.title: Enterprise financial agents described as future architecture
bullets: Dacheng’s research-system investment is current, but autonomous collaboration remains a future vision; separate risk controls are not explicitly AI-based.

entries.source_note: 鹏华基金 and listed vendor 赢时胜 (300377) 「联合成功上线行业首个『AI原生+信创双轮驱动的新一代TA资金清算系统』Alpha版本」 — jointly brought live the Alpha version of what they call the industry's first AI-native, fully domestic-stack new-generation TA fund-clearing system — with Penghua's self-developed 「玄渊」 large model deeply integrated into it, moving settlement 「从『事后核算』到『事前预测、事中控制』的智能化跃迁」 (company claim; carrier tier unresolved — see footnote)
entries.title: AI-native fund-clearing system launches in alpha
bullets: Penghua and its vendor integrate the Xuanyuan model into settlement; the claim’s source-tier status remains unresolved.

entries.source_note: In 中国基金报's roundup of 头部公募 AI programmes (记者 闫军), 鹏华基金 states that 「公司自主研发的智能投研平台整合海量底层数据、舆情监控、因子分析、组合风险管理等功能模块，为基金经理提供实时、多维的决策支持，同时极大提升了研究员的研究广度与深度」 — its self-developed intelligent investment-research platform integrates bulk underlying data, sentiment monitoring, factor analysis and portfolio risk management into real-time, multi-dimensional decision support for portfolio managers and broadens analyst research; the paragraph carries no 大模型 or AI vocabulary (company claim)
entries.title: Internal platform supports research and portfolio risk
bullets: Penghua describes data, sentiment and factor analysis, but the quoted passage does not explicitly identify AI or large models.

entries.source_note: Publishes its 2026 management-innovation plan under the title 「사학연금, 인공지능(AI)·디지털 기반 '지능형 연금·복지 서비스 기관'으로 도약」 — Teachers' Pension leaps to an AI- and digital-based "intelligent pension and welfare service institution" (goal statement; release body available only as a Hangul attachment)
entries.title: Management plan targets AI-enabled pension services
bullets: The announcement states an institutional goal; the detailed release is available only as a Hangul attachment.

entries.source_note: Announces 「공공기관 최초 인공지능(AI) 혁신자문위원'티(T)-쌤' 위촉 '휴먼(Human)-인공지능(AI)' 협력 거버넌스 구축」 — the appointment of an AI innovation advisor named T-쌤, described as the first by a Korean public institution, and the building of a human–AI cooperative governance model (company claim)
entries.title: T-쌤 appointed as AI innovation adviser
bullets: Korea Teachers Pension presents the appointment as part of a human–AI governance model; it is a company claim.

entries.source_note: Formally launches its 혁신보드 (innovation board) composed of 「내외부 실무 전문가」, internal and external practitioners — the innovation body to which the April AI advisory appointment attaches
entries.title: Innovation board formally launched
bullets: Internal and external practitioners join the body linked to the earlier AI advisory appointment.

entries.source_note: The firm's IT head states 「公司已在DeepSeek-R1开源版本上完成了私有化部署」 — the company has completed private deployment on the open-source DeepSeek-R1 version — and describes the model as 「展现出应用价值」, showing application value, across investment research, risk management, product operations, software development and internal knowledge-base management, with deeper integration into business needs framed as a subsequent-stage plan
entries.title: DeepSeek-R1 deployed privately
bullets: Invesco Great Wall names promising business applications, while deeper integration is described as a subsequent step.

entries.source_note: Reported to have built an investment research platform 「基于AI、云原生等前沿技术」 — on AI, cloud-native and other frontier technologies — with front-end and interface integration as the core approach, supporting its fixed income+, fixed income, ETF, pension FOF, active management and quantitative strategy businesses
entries.title: AI-based research platform supports multiple strategies
bullets: The reported system spans fixed income, ETFs, pension funds, active management and quantitative investing.

entries.source_note: 21世纪经济报道's 大模型重塑金融业态 series reports the firm's generative-AI platform as launched: 「工银瑞信基金上线的FundGPT在数字人问答技术、检索增强大模型、数据分析师伴侣、AI助手等领域都取得了技术突破」 — FundGPT, launched by ICBC Credit Suisse, has achieved technical breakthroughs in digital-human Q&A, retrieval-augmented large models, a data-analyst companion and AI assistants. The launch verb 上线 is completive, but the predicate is a technical-breakthrough claim and no user count, adoption rate or per-function deployment is given
entries.title: FundGPT launch names four technical capabilities
bullets: ICBC’s platform covers Q&A, retrieval, data analysis and assistants, but no adoption rate or per-function deployment count is disclosed.

entries.source_note: Named in 21世纪经济报道's census of public fund managers' DeepSeek deployments: 「而工银瑞信则完成DeepSeek-V3/R1 671B版本部署」 — ICBC Credit Suisse, for its part, completed deployment of the DeepSeek-V3/R1 671B version. The census gives the firm this single clause and names no application built on the deployment
entries.title: DeepSeek-V3/R1 671B deployment completed
bullets: The industry census confirms installation without naming an application built on it.

entries.source_note: 工银瑞信基金 is one of the drafting units of 中基协's 《基金经营机构大模型技术应用规范》 (T/AMAC 0004-2026, published 2026-04-03) alongside 易方达/华夏/中金财富/九坤/阿里云/华为.
entries.title: Firm helps draft large-model application standard
bullets: ICBC Credit Suisse is listed among the drafting organizations for AMAC’s fund-industry standard.

entries.source_note: 中国基金报's roundup of AI adoption at leading public fund managers carries two firm-attributed passages: 「工银瑞信基金推动智能投研平台与智能风控平台全面对接，将合规要求前置到投资试算、组合构建等环节，实现"先合规、后投资"。同时打造IBOR实时交易数据中心，为风控规则的实时、刚性执行提供数据底座支撑」 — the intelligent investment-research and risk platforms fully interfaced, compliance requirements moved ahead of investment trial-calculation and portfolio construction, and an IBOR real-time trading data centre built as the data foundation for real-time, rigid enforcement of risk rules — and 「工银瑞信基金表示，公司已成立AI应用工程部，组建专职FDE前端敏捷作战创新智能投研柔性团队，深化业技融合」, the firm stating it has established an AI application engineering department and a dedicated FDE agile flexible team for intelligent investment research
entries.title: AI engineering department and research team established
bullets: The firm also describes integrated research and risk platforms that place compliance checks before investment actions.

entries.source_note: Launches XTY Labs, a machine learning division headed by Dr. Atlas Wang with an AI Residency Program, whose mission is to "swiftly integrate successful models into the market, directly enhancing XTX Market's trading strategies and operations"; discloses a research cluster of "100,000 cores and 20,000 A/V100 GPUs and is growing"
entries.title: XTY Labs launches with AI residency program
bullets: The machine-learning division aims to move successful models into trading and operations, supported by a large research cluster.

entries.source_note: Announces plans to invest "over €1bn" in a data centre complex in Kajaani, Finland — its first owned large-scale data centre — stating "these deep learning models require significant computational resources" and citing a research cluster of "over 25,000 GPUs with 650 petabytes of usable storage"
entries.title: XTX plans data-center investment above €1bn
bullets: The Finland project is intended to support compute-intensive deep-learning research; the announcement describes a planned facility.

entries.source_note: Publishes the engineering account of TernFS, an exabyte-scale distributed filesystem XTX built in-house after outgrowing NFS and commercial options: "more than 500PB across 30,000 disks, 10,000 flash drives, and three data centres" serving "multiple terabytes per second", and "by mid-2024 all of our machine learning efforts were driven out of TernFS"
entries.title: TernFS underpins all machine-learning workloads
bullets: XTX’s engineering account says the internal filesystem supported all ML efforts by mid-2024, across more than 500PB of storage.

entries.source_note: Partners with Google Cloud for automated trading research: "HRT's quant researchers will no longer be limited to on-premise assets and can now test new strategies in a shorter amount of time in a cost-effective manner"; compute lead Gerard Bernabeu Altayo cites "a fast path from inception to scale-out production"
entries.title: Google Cloud partnership expands trading-research compute
bullets: HRT describes faster strategy testing and a path from research to scaled production.

entries.source_note: Publishes an HRT AI Labs project on its own engineering blog: a diffusion model trained on stock returns to generate synthetic return sequences, with the evaluation methods used to judge them (research output, not a production deployment)
entries.title: AI Labs publishes synthetic-return research
bullets: A diffusion model generates stock-return sequences; this is research output, not a production deployment.

entries.source_note: We discuss the firm's attempts to use AI not just for more efficient trading, but also to make short-term predictions about price, which further gives its traders an edge. Dunning walks us through his work, his views on the main constraints facing the space (labor, power, chips, etc.) and how his work is both different and similar to what's happening at the major cutting edge research labs like ChatGPT.
entries.title: HRT discusses AI for short-term price prediction
bullets: The interview covers trading research and constraints including talent, power and chips, without supplying adoption metrics.

entries.source_note: Hudson River Trading Accelerates Algorithmic Trading With NVIDIA AI Factory
entries.title: NVIDIA AI Factory announcement targets algorithmic trading
bullets: The source note identifies trading acceleration but provides no further deployment or usage detail.

entries.source_note: Lambda announces a partnership to power HRT's quantitative research and development, stating that "HRT's researchers run compute-intensive workloads to train models and simulate trading strategies at scale"; HRT compute systems lead Gerard Bernabeu Altayo is named
entries.title: Lambda partnership supports model training and simulation
bullets: The vendor describes compute-intensive quantitative research and trading-strategy workloads at HRT.

entries.source_note: CoreWeave announces a multi-year agreement under which HRT will use its AI cloud platform for "AI research and model development at scale"; HRT Head of Research & Development Kevin Lee: "As we scale our AI and machine learning research, the AI platform we build on matters as much as the models we build"
entries.title: CoreWeave agreement expands AI research capacity
bullets: HRT plans to use the platform for model development at scale under a multi-year agreement.

entries.source_note: Own blog: a Jane Street designer reports building interactive prototypes of internal apps directly with Claude — "In the past 2 months the situations where I've reached for Figma have fallen off a cliff" and "for some new apps I'm even skipping Figma entirely, iterating on the visual design from the beginning with Claude" (one designer's account; the post gives no firm-wide adoption figure)
entries.title: Designer uses Claude for internal-app prototypes
bullets: The account describes one employee’s workflow changes, without a firm-wide adoption figure.

entries.source_note: CoreWeave announces an approximately $6 billion AI cloud agreement giving Jane Street next-generation compute, describing the work as "training large, complex models on massive volumes of noisy data, refining them continuously, and deploying at a scale to help make markets more efficient" and citing Jane Street's "continued focus on applying machine learning across its business"
entries.title: Jane Street signs approximately $6bn AI cloud agreement
bullets: CoreWeave describes infrastructure for training, refining and deploying complex models on large datasets.

entries.source_note: CoreWeave customer post: "Since 2024, Jane Street has relied on CoreWeave to provide a full-stack compute solution", used "to train its next generation of trading models" and to support "machine learning and research workloads" as the firm grew "its training and inference workloads"; Jane Street Head of Quant Research Craig Falls is quoted
entries.title: CoreWeave supports trading-model training since 2024
bullets: The customer story describes expanding training, inference and research workloads, with Jane Street’s quant research head quoted.

entries.source_note: Own blog: "We developed our own Claude Code–ish tool, called AIDE, (which we built to maintain the freedom to choose between different model vendors, to suit our unusual development environment, and to better control the execution sandbox)"; the same post reports an engineer building a working internal TUI prototype "in less than ten minutes" with AI agents, and internal expect tests written so "the AI [can] check its own work"
entries.title: AIDE built as internal coding-agent tool
bullets: Jane Street designs the tool for model choice, its development environment and sandbox control; an engineer reports rapid prototyping.

entries.source_note: 4Q/FY 2025 results: the firm states it "expanded our investments in intelligent system management for our trading infrastructure", that it continues "investing in research engineering" and is "deploying a dedicated Deep Learning initiative applied to trading strategies", and that it is "accelerating the deployment of AI supported analytics to drive trading efficiencies" (no named tool, team size or adoption figure given)
entries.title: Results describe deep-learning trading initiative
bullets: Flow Traders reports investment in research engineering and AI analytics, without naming a tool or adoption figure.

entries.source_note: Flow Traders describes AI and deep learning as core technology enablers and is building a technology environment linking quantitative research to automated execution, with benefits expected from 2H2027 onward.
entries.title: AI technology program targets benefits from late 2027
bullets: Flow Traders is building infrastructure linking quantitative research and automated execution; benefits remain prospective.

entries.source_note: CoreWeave announces Flow Traders has selected it as AI cloud platform provider for the firm's "recently announced AI and deep learning division", marking "Flow Traders' migration of high-intensity training workloads to CoreWeave Cloud" and "dedicated compute capacity to support the training of foundation models at the core of its AI-driven quantitative trading strategy"; the release states that Flow Traders "prepares to go live with its AI and deep learning division" and quotes co-head Joshua Mathew
entries.title: CoreWeave selected ahead of AI division launch
bullets: The agreement provides model-training capacity as Flow Traders prepares the division to go live.

entries.source_note: 2Q 2026 results carry no present-tense AI deployment: CEO Thomas Spitz cites "continued technology investments" and "attracting experienced talent with a focus on technology and AI", and says management will "share our Horizon 2030 vision to become the 24/7 liquidity provider of choice" with a "progress update on Horizon 2030" due at full-year results
entries.title: Quarterly results emphasize AI talent and investment
bullets: Management outlines Horizon 2030 plans without disclosing a present-tense AI deployment.

entries.source_note: Own engineering post "Why DevEx matters to Optiver" states the firm has "already invested in Cursor and GitHub Copilot to explore how AI can support writing and reviewing code", that the aim "isn't to adopt every new tool on the market, but to integrate the right ones across the development cycle", and that this means "tailoring AI models and workflows to Optiver's development lifecycle" — while adding "it's still early days"
entries.title: Cursor and Copilot explored for software development
bullets: Optiver describes early work adapting tools to its coding and review processes.

entries.source_note: Rob Hahn, Global Head of Optiver Research Platform, publishes "Research at scale: Orchestrating ML for systematic trading", describing the in-house research engine that supports thousands of parallel ML experiments across decades of market data and naming "GraphRunner", a component Optiver built to decide what is ready to run next
entries.title: GraphRunner coordinates large-scale ML research
bullets: Optiver’s in-house platform supports thousands of parallel experiments across decades of market data.

entries.source_note: Own AI-engineering post "Where AI trading models work (and where they still fall short)" reports that LLM systems are "already widely used within Optiver for analysis, prototyping and education", while its subject is a test of current models against Optiver's own intern exam and six-month trader assessment, concluding the models fall short
entries.title: LLMs widely used for analysis and prototyping
bullets: Optiver also tests models against trader assessments and finds they still fall short.

entries.source_note: Head of Platform Engineering Pat Cooney says "agentic AI is increasingly just the way people build systems", that "we're building with AI, but also building for AI", and that "we also have bots integrated speaking with technologists and users and making changes in the environment"
entries.title: Engineering teams describe agentic development workflows
bullets: Optiver reports bots interacting with staff and making changes in its environment.

entries.source_note: In a joint Databricks–Optiver piece, Global CTO Lance Braunstein says the firm "has invested heavily in tooling, education and access to large language models", and Head of Data Platforms Christophe Godefroy describes work to "build common platforms" reducing complexity across teams and regions
entries.title: Common platforms support growing AI access
bullets: Optiver describes investment in LLM tooling and education, alongside work to reduce infrastructure complexity across teams.

entries.source_note: Microsoft's customer story documents a phased Microsoft 365 Copilot rollout — begun in the technology department under Microsoft's Early Adoption Programme and “extended to include marketing, investment, legal, HR, and finance teams” — with Group CIO David Reynolds, Head of Audit Alex Krupa (“we mapped AI to our internal audit lifecycle”) and Quilter Cheviot investment manager Freddie Collins (“with Copilot, the breakeven point is a month”) on the record
entries.title: Copilot expands across business functions
bullets: Microsoft documents phased access from technology into marketing, investments, legal, HR and finance, with named staff examples.

entries.source_note: Aveni announces that Aveni Assist is “now live across its appointed representative firms” and “has been deployed to all advisers across the Quilter network” to record, transcribe and summarise client meetings, and that it “is being used internally across the business as well”; chief distribution officer Steve Gazard says increasing use of “AI in particular, is becoming essential to strengthening how advisers work with clients”
entries.title: Aveni Assist deployed across adviser network
bullets: The vendor reports live meeting recording, transcription and summaries, plus use inside Quilter’s own business.

entries.source_note: Annual Report 2025 (Sustainability / people section): Quilter “accelerated enterprise-wide AI capability through a targeted rollout of Copilot, underpinned by a strong focus on responsible adoption” — “Over 160 Copilot Champions were upskilled to support peer learning and advocacy, alongside organisation-wide training delivered through a bespoke e-learning module”, with colleagues “embraced the training, with 92% completing the introductory module” (training completion, not a usage rate). Group AuMA £141.2bn at 31 December 2025
entries.title: AI training reaches 92% introductory completion
bullets: Quilter reports over 160 Copilot Champions; the 92% figure measures training completion, not tool usage.

entries.source_note: CEO's Review, in the strategic report: “we have rolled out an AI solution for advisers that allows them to record, transcribe, and summarise meetings and actions, significantly reducing the time it takes to complete certain administrative tasks”, with the next iteration adding recommendation capacity; the Advice Transformation Programme aims to improve productivity “through enhanced Client Relationship Management systems with integrated support tools, including AI tools”, and AI is being integrated into business infrastructure “to enhance risk management by allowing faster and more effective compliance file checking”
entries.title: Adviser AI automates meeting administration
bullets: Quilter describes recording, transcription and summaries; recommendation features remain a next iteration.

entries.source_note: Pictet AM's Quest AI stock-selection model goes live; the firm's Quest technology and data-science team later dates the strategy's launch to July 2023
entries.title: Quest AI stock-selection model goes live
bullets: Pictet’s technology team later dates the strategy launch to July 2023.

entries.source_note: Swiss AI vendor Unique announces the go-live of One.Chat, the GPT-powered internal platform it co-developed with Pictet on Azure OpenAI — rolled out to over 5,000 group employees, with 3,000 having used it and 1,200 using it weekly for internal information retrieval, regulatory-compliance lookups, drafting, summarising and translating; Steve Blanchet, Head of Technology and Innovation at Pictet Group, is on the record
entries.title: One.Chat rolls out to over 5,000 group employees
bullets: Unique reports 1,200 weekly users for retrieval, drafting and compliance queries; these are Pictet Group figures.

entries.source_note: Pictet publishes an interview with investment manager Alexandra Nagy on the Quest AI-Driven strategy: USD 1.7bn raised over 18 months, a boosted-tree model trained on ~400 features and retrained every three months under Stéphane Daul's quantitative team, and the stage-capping detail that “validation by investment managers is needed before any of the model's recommended trades are executed”
entries.title: Quest AI-Driven strategy raises $1.7bn
bullets: Pictet describes a retrained boosted-tree model, with investment managers approving recommended trades before execution.

entries.source_note: Pictet's Quest technology and data-science team publishes the model's build-out: engineered features roughly doubled from about 200, data observations up more than tenfold to several billions, and compute from under 100 CPUs to over 3,000, with corresponding growth in servers and GPUs
entries.title: Quest expands data, features and computing capacity
bullets: Pictet reports several billion observations and more than 3,000 CPUs supporting model development.

entries.source_note: Pictet’s innovative approach goes beyond factor or language models, stripping style, size, sector, and region biases to reveal what truly drives each stock’s return. Our AI zeroes in on these signals to help predict future performance. Using AI for client-facing product (AI-enhanced investment product)
entries.title: Client-facing AI strategy describes stock-return prediction
bullets: The product account emphasizes removing common biases to identify return signals; it is an investment-product application.

entries.source_note: 幻方-基础研究 publishes HAI-LLM, the firm's in-house large-model training framework — 「基于萤火集群的特性而自研」 (custom-developed for its own 萤火 GPU cluster), implementing ZeRO data, pipeline, tensor and sequence parallelism and scaling to thousands of GPUs
entries.title: HAI-LLM training framework published
bullets: High-Flyer describes internal technology built for its Fire-Fly GPU cluster and scaling to thousands of GPUs.

entries.source_note: 「以DeepSeek背后的幻方量化为例，私募排排网数据显示，公司策略开发团队有100多人，其中AI Lab有20多人」; 「早在2020年3月幻方量化就已经正式启用了'萤火一号'超算平台，后续还投建了'萤火二号'」.
entries.title: Report identifies AI lab within strategy-development team
bullets: The account names more than twenty AI Lab staff and provides historical context on the firm’s supercomputing infrastructure.

entries.source_note: 21世纪经济报道 reports 「目前，幻方量化管理规模已超700亿元」 and a 2025 mean return of 56.55%, restating that the firm's first deep-learning-generated trading position went live on 21 October 2016 and that it 「2017年全面应用深度学习技术进行交易」, and that DeepSeek's research budget comes from High-Flyer's R&D budget
entries.title: Deep-learning trading history reported alongside current scale
bullets: Coverage cites over RMB 70bn managed and past adoption across trading; the early implementation dates remain historical context.

entries.source_note: 한국경제 interview identifies 김홍곤 as 「KB자산운용 AI퀀트&DI운용부문장」, head of the firm's AI Quant & DI investment division, arguing that the binding constraints on AI in Korean asset management are regulation and talent rather than technology — 「AI는 자산운용 패러다임을 진짜로 바꿀 수 있다」 (the remarks themselves are advocacy; the named division is the fact counted here)
entries.title: AI Quant and DI division identified
bullets: The interview establishes a named investment division; its broader claims about AI’s potential are advocacy.

entries.source_note: 한국경제 reports 「KB자산운용은 앤더슨을 기반으로 'KB 글로벌주식솔루션EMP 펀드', 'KB 올에셋AI솔루션EMP 펀드' 등을 운용 중이다」 — the firm runs two public EMP funds on 앤더슨(ANDERSON), the deep-learning system it built in-house from 2016 to analyse global market data and produce optimal portfolios
entries.title: Two public funds run on ANDERSON
bullets: KB’s in-house deep-learning system analyzes global market data to produce portfolios for the named EMP funds.

entries.source_note: 서울경제: 「자산운용 업계 최초로 생성형 인공지능(AI) 기반의 아나운서를 자체 콘텐츠에 도입했다」 — deploys a generative-AI announcer into production of ETF and fund explainers, market briefings, webinars and event promotion video, described as an industry first and as extending AI use in step with the group's AI/digital transformation (company claim)
entries.title: Generative-AI announcer enters content production
bullets: KB uses the presenter in fund explainers, market briefings and promotional videos; the industry-first claim is company-supplied.

entries.source_note: Own Elomedia article "Tekoäly tulee myös eläkeyhtiöön": the customer-service chatbot handled 26,000 conversations in 2023 and resolved 77% without a human (60% positive feedback); AI already supports the pension-granting decision process though a person always makes the decision; Microsoft M365 Copilot named as an emerging tool
entries.title: Chatbot resolves 77% of conversations without humans
bullets: Elo reports 26,000 chats in 2023 and AI support for pension processing, while people retain final decisions.

entries.source_note: CEO Carl Pettersson tells IPE that Elo uses AI to identify population-level phenomena weakening employees' work ability — workload factors and patterns behind mental-health-related disability — and that "AI doesn't make investment decisions, but it supports investment operations, above all in the preparation of analyses" and in scenario modelling, alongside ICT renewal, background processes and customer service (company claims)
entries.title: AI supports work-ability and investment analysis
bullets: Elo’s CEO describes disability-pattern research, scenarios and operational uses, explicitly retaining human investment decisions.

entries.source_note: H1 2026 interim report puts the market value of Elo's investments at "36,3 (34,4 vuoden 2025 lopussa) miljardia euroa" as of 30 June 2026 and makes no internal-AI claim of any kind — the AUM source, and the limit of what Elo's own periodic reporting discloses about adoption
entries.title: Interim report supplies AUM without AI disclosure
bullets: The report provides financial context but makes no internal-adoption claim.

entries.source_note: Own annual report records a milestone in process automation — "KLP passerer en milepæl ved å ta i bruk helautomatisk behandling av alle nye søknader om alderspensjon" (fully automatic handling of all new old-age pension applications) — and a new digital pension system completed during 2025 that automates large parts of pension processing. Rule-based automation, not an AI claim: the same report contains no mention of kunstig intelligens, KI, AI, maskinlæring or Copilot anywhere
entries.title: Pension automation does not establish AI use
bullets: KLP reports automated application processing, but the annual report contains no explicit AI claim.

entries.source_note: EVP of technology Rune Hørnes tells IPE that KLP is in the early stages of adopting AI and gradually scaling its use across the organisation, naming Microsoft Copilot with Edge and M365, GitHub Copilot for software development, domain assistants BankingGPT and PropertyGPT, and Pythia, a KLP-developed assistant that helps employees find and use internal knowledge across systems and domains; customer-facing use is "just beginning to explore". He cites GDPR and data-residency concerns and states that governance, guidelines and user awareness are still needed (company claims)
entries.title: Pythia and domain assistants support staff
bullets: KLP names Copilot, BankingGPT and PropertyGPT, while customer-facing uses and stronger governance remain under exploration.

entries.source_note: Q2 2026 report puts group total assets at "1 395 887" million kroner as of 30 June 2026 and makes no internal-AI claim; artificial intelligence appears only as a driver of global economic activity — the AUM source, and the limit of what KLP's own periodic reporting discloses about adoption
entries.title: Quarterly report adds no internal AI evidence
bullets: KLP mentions AI only as an economic driver; the document serves as a financial-scale source.

entries.source_note: An independent report said the foundation had used its own AI system to screen about 800 applications for an AI for Economic Opportunity grant round received in September (event year unspecified); the foundation president said screening took about 30 minutes (company claim)
entries.title: Foundation reports rapid AI screening of grant applications
bullets: Independent coverage cites about 800 applications screened in thirty minutes; timing and performance come from the foundation’s account.

entries.source_note: The foundation described an internal AI-enabled tool for synthesizing grantee reports and research literature, and staff use of Grant Guardian in its own grant diligence (foundation claim)
entries.title: Grant Guardian supports internal grant diligence
bullets: The foundation also describes an AI tool synthesizing grantee reports and research literature.

entries.source_note: CIO Australia's CIO50 Awards Australia 2023 profile of Aware Super chief technology officer Richard Exton describes the Catalyst end-to-end transformation, stating that straight-through processing cut online transactions from weeks to minutes "while artificial intelligence is used to identify unstructured member information in documents and verify that relevant information is correctly captured in its systems" — the only named, shipped internal AI use in Aware Super's public record (company account, given through an awards profile; the page shows no visible publication date)
entries.title: AI checks unstructured member-document information
bullets: An awards profile describes document identification and verification within Aware Super’s transformation program; the account is company-supplied.

entries.source_note: Aware Super's Annual Report 2024 (issued September 2024) lists Artificial Intelligence among the fund's material issues and states that Aware has "made security, privacy and ethical considerations an absolute priority, creating processes and a Responsible AI Framework to guide internal usage", that it is "exploring viable AI use cases with careful examination of the costs, risks and upside benefits", and that it is "taking steps to educate staff to safely make use of AI-enabled technology within the scope of their day-to-day responsibilities"
entries.title: Responsible AI Framework guides exploration and training
bullets: Aware Super’s annual report prioritizes privacy, security and ethics while assessing viable use cases.

entries.source_note: Aware Super's Annual Report 2025 (issued September 2025) states "AI is a central pillar of our innovation strategy. We've made strong progress in embedding AI across our operations, guided and overseen by our AI Risk Management Framework" and that "These solutions are already delivering measurable benefits" (company claims — no tool, team, use case or penetration figure is named anywhere in the report); it also records AI masterclasses and tool showcases, a structured training program in generative AI, data literacy and critical thinking, and a new online learning platform to lift AI and data literacy, and carries "To be at the forefront in leveraging data, technology and AI" as one of the fund's stated strategic priorities
entries.title: Annual report claims operational AI benefits
bullets: Aware Super names governance and training, but supplies no tool, team, use-case or penetration figures.

entries.source_note: Aware Super announces that Richard Exton becomes Group Executive, Chief Technology and Data Officer effective 1 November 2025, reporting directly to CEO Deanne Stewart; the release says the appointment "elevates technology, data and AI leadership to the executive team", quotes Stewart saying the 200-strong Technology team will "continue to embed AI and digital innovation across the business to deliver even more personalised and secure digital experiences", and adds "This appointment demonstrates how integral AI, data and technology is in supporting our strategic priorities to 2030"
entries.title: Technology, data and AI leadership reaches executive team
bullets: Richard Exton’s new role reports to the CEO and includes continued AI development across the business.

entries.source_note: Reporting the appointment, iTnews states that "The fund confirmed to iTnews that development and deployment of AI will be key deliverables for Exton in his new role, with a focus on improved efficiency, productivity and more personalised member services" and that "It declined to reveal specific details of the fund's upcoming AI transformation projects and initiatives" — independent confirmation that as of late 2025 Aware Super's AI deployment was prospective and undisclosed
entries.title: AI deployment named as new executive’s responsibility
bullets: iTnews confirms the mandate, while Aware Super declines to detail upcoming projects.

entries.source_note: AustralianSuper joins Microsoft's Copilot for Microsoft 365 Early Access Program as one of roughly 600 organisations invited globally; the trial begins in late 2023 with 100 employees planned and expands to around 260 active users (vendor account)
entries.title: Copilot early-access trial expands to around 260 users
bullets: Microsoft describes a trial beginning with 100 planned employees in late 2023.

entries.source_note: Microsoft publishes a feature on AustralianSuper's internal AI use: a dedicated AI engineering team, participation in the Security Copilot Early Access Program for its cyber defence team, GitHub Copilot in software development, an internal chatbot over the fund's policies and standards, and an AI Governance Forum; CTO Mike Backeberg puts the fund's AI maturity at "only at level one on the five-point scale that we're using" and targets a 5 per cent productivity gain within 12 months (company claim)
entries.title: AI team, tools and governance forum described
bullets: AustralianSuper names coding, cybersecurity and policy-chatbot applications, but rates its maturity at level one of five.

entries.source_note: Chief Investment Officer reports AustralianSuper naming its first head of AI and automation, and quotes chief platforms officer Mike Backeberg that the fund "has already embraced AI and automation across its business" and is working to "align autonomous agents with human intent, embed guardrails without killing momentum and turn experimentation into repeatable scaled outcomes" (company claim)
entries.title: First head of AI and automation appointed
bullets: AustralianSuper describes existing use and work toward repeatable agent workflows with human alignment and safeguards.

entries.source_note: Institutional Investor reports Blackstone's AI in production inside the investment process: head of North America private equity Martin Brand says AI tools build "a high-quality first model while I'm still on the phone" and that this is "already used throughout our private-equity business"; Blackstone's own AI platform turns a two-to-three-day first-task memo into hours; Sourcegraph's Cody halves engineering work; Microsoft 365 handles boilerplate and Salesforce Einstein GPT supports private wealth (company claims made on the record to a T2 outlet)
entries.title: AI supports private-equity models and memos
bullets: Blackstone claims faster investment work and coding productivity, with examples reported by Institutional Investor.

entries.source_note: In Blackstone's own leaders Q&A, CTO John Stecher answers how the firm uses AI internally: in-house AI solutions "designed to strengthen our investment processes, compare lease and property data and benchmark our performance against industry peers", predictive tools already in use (Vectra for cyber-threat investigation, 73 Strings for portfolio monitoring and valuations), and external generative tools — helpdesk chatbots, coding tools and Microsoft 365 Copilot — that the firm is "starting to introduce" (company claim)
entries.title: CTO describes internal investment and monitoring tools
bullets: Blackstone names property analysis, cyber-threat detection and valuations, while some generative tools are only being introduced.

entries.source_note: Blackstone first discloses its own internal AI use in an SEC annual report: the FY2024 Form 10-K states that "our employees can utilize internal generative AI-powered applications to help summarize, search or translate documents or gather information on a wide variety of topics" — language absent from the FY2023 10-K filed 2024-02-23 and repeated in the FY2025 10-K filed 2026-02-27 (company claim; availability, not a measured usage rate)
entries.title: Annual filing discloses internal GenAI application access
bullets: Employees can summarize, search and translate documents; the filing establishes availability, not measured usage.

entries.source_note: Blackstone publishes a CTO / Operating Team interview stating that "Our private equity and real estate teams are deploying very targeted tools — for example, to help move quicker from raw deal documents to financial models", that AI is used "at the very top of the funnel" so the firm can "evaluate opportunities faster, say no faster", and that reviewing thousands of deal documents "used to be a weekend-long activity [and] can now be carried out in minutes"; CTO John Stecher adds "My teams are meaningfully more productive than they were a year ago" (company claims)
entries.title: Deal teams report faster document-to-model workflows
bullets: Blackstone claims targeted AI tools reduce some screening tasks from a weekend to minutes.

entries.source_note: PSP's fiscal 2024 annual report states it is "exploring ways to integrate these technologies into our business model" and that "In fiscal 2024, we held organization-wide GenAI learning sessions and rolled out Microsoft Copilot, an AI-powered productivity tool" (company claim — no licence count or usage rate disclosed); the same report records external speakers on generative AI at Board director-education sessions
entries.title: Copilot rollout accompanies organization-wide GenAI learning
bullets: PSP’s annual report names deployment and board education without publishing license counts or usage rates.

entries.source_note: Chief Investment Officer reports on PSP's fiscal 2024 sustainability report, quoting sustainability head Herman Bril that "Our increasing use of technology and data has been noteworthy in advancing our approach to sustainability" and that "With breakthroughs in generative artificial intelligence, we see even more potential to drive efficiencies" — intent, not deployment; the underlying report says PSP "expect[s] to use GenAI tools"
entries.title: Sustainability report anticipates GenAI efficiency gains
bullets: The statements express expected benefits and intended use, without establishing a new deployment.

entries.source_note: PSP's fiscal 2025 annual report states the digital innovation team "formally joined the Global Alpha group" and, renamed Alpha Science, "now works closely with deal teams across PSP Investments to validate or challenge investment theses through the use of cutting-edge technologies"; some 800 employees attended a second annual Technology and Data Week with "a strong focus on generative AI"
entries.title: Alpha Science joins Global Alpha investment group
bullets: The team works with deal teams on investment theses; a technology week attended by about 800 staff emphasizes generative AI.

entries.source_note: PSP's fiscal 2026 annual report describes "structured deployment across our organization" of "a number of strategic generative AI tools" with "commensurate governance and appropriate responsible use protocols," names an Alpha Science "AI-powered research assistant agent" for investment professionals and a Cybersecurity "AI agent that works alongside our security analysts," and reports Global Alpha "deploying PSP Investments' proprietary AI research platform" across Public and Private Markets; AI is a named enterprise-risk category (company claims — no penetration or usage figures given)
entries.title: Research and cybersecurity agents named in annual report
bullets: PSP describes structured deployment and responsible-use controls across the organization, without publishing usage or penetration figures.

entries.source_note: Partners Group's Sustainability Report 2024 (calendar-2024 reporting period) reports internal AI in production firm-wide: "Up to 75% of employees now use AI tools regularly" (company claim) and names three deployed tools — PRIMERA GPT, a "ringfenced internal GPT tool" integrated as a standard inside the Edge browser for document analysis, ideation research and proposal development; Microsoft 365 Copilot; and a GenAI search reaching data across Partners Group's locations under each user's individual access rights
entries.title: Regular AI use reported by up to 75% of staff
bullets: Partners Group names PRIMERA GPT, Copilot and access-controlled internal search; the adoption figure is company-supplied.

entries.source_note: Partners Group's 2025 Corporate Sustainability Report (calendar-2025 reporting period, published 22 April 2026) describes an AI adoption program "throughout the firm, systematically tracking a portfolio of AI initiatives across all business functions": generative AI extended into its proprietary PG Alpha monitoring platform as "Alpha Intelligence", an uplifted search over decades of proprietary information, AI-assisted RFP responses and marketing-material review, the PRIMERA.ai internal LLM platform alongside Microsoft Copilot, AI literacy sessions that "equipped more than 400 employees", and AI embedded "across the full investment lifecycle – from sourcing and diligence to investment committee processes, value creation, and exits" (company claims)
entries.title: Alpha Intelligence and PRIMERA.ai extend internal AI use
bullets: Partners Group describes applications across the investment lifecycle, reporting and marketing, plus training for over 400 employees.

entries.source_note: In its H1 2026 ad-hoc announcement, Partners Group attributes part of a firm-level cost decline to internal AI: "Total operating costs decreased by 5% to CHF 414 million (H1 2025: CHF 435 million), mainly driven by lower variable performance fee-related personnel expenses and AI-driven productivity gains" (company claim — the AI share of the 5% is not broken out)
entries.title: Company partly attributes cost decline to AI productivity
bullets: Operating costs fall 5%, but Partners Group does not separate AI savings from lower variable compensation.

entries.source_note: finews.ch independently reports the same attribution in its coverage of the H1 2026 results, writing that Partners Group traces the 5% fall in operating expenses to CHF 414 million partly to "Produktivitätssteigerungen durch künstliche Intelligenz" ("productivity gains through artificial intelligence")
entries.title: Independent coverage repeats AI cost-saving attribution
bullets: finews reports management’s explanation of the 5% expense decline; it does not independently quantify the AI contribution.

entries.source_note: In a Q&A on its own site, Hamilton Lane's Head of Technology Solutions says the firm uses “technology that integrates machine learning to extract unstructured data from GP documentation as part of our data management service for LPs” and is “using technology to digitize our diligence process, specifically how we interact with and collect data from general partners”; the only generative-AI item named is the client-facing Helix BY HL chatbot, which the firm calls “early days” (company claim)
entries.title: Machine learning extracts data from GP documents
bullets: Hamilton Lane describes internal diligence digitization; its named generative chatbot is client-facing and still described as early-stage.

entries.source_note: Hamilton Lane publishes a Q&A between its Head of Technology Solutions and its Director of Valuation stating “we partnered with 73 Strings to standardize the process across all private market strategies” and that “our partnerships with cutting-edge private markets fintech platforms like 73 Strings are helping us revolutionize and scale valuation and portfolio monitoring with AI” — the firm's one named, dated internal AI deployment (company claim; no usage figures)
entries.title: 73 Strings supports valuation and portfolio monitoring
bullets: Hamilton Lane identifies the partnership as an internal AI deployment across private-market strategies, without usage figures.

entries.source_note: Hamilton Lane's FY2025 Form 10-K first discloses internal AI use in a risk factor, stating only “We use and plan to expand our use of AI tools and technologies in the operation of our business”, with no functional area named
entries.title: Annual filing first acknowledges internal AI use
bullets: Hamilton Lane states that it uses and plans to expand AI, without naming business functions.

entries.source_note: Hamilton Lane's FY2026 Form 10-K expands the disclosure to four named internal domains — “to support investment research and portfolio analytics, enhance client reporting and investor education, assist with software development and other technology workflows, and help automate certain operational, compliance and legal processes” — adds a governance clause on “how we design, implement, monitor, document or govern our internal use of AI tools” against “our own policies and procedures”, and discloses that the firm is “aware of unauthorized use of non-approved consumer AI tools by our employees”
entries.title: Filing expands AI scope and identifies governance concerns
bullets: Hamilton Lane names investment, reporting, software and operational uses, and discloses unauthorized employee use of unapproved consumer tools.

entries.source_note: Hamilton Lane posts an “AI Strategy & Operations Associate” requisition (R003088, Conshohocken) describing an operating internal AI programme: coordination “across embedded AI teams” against roadmaps, ROI reporting “using the firm's existing ROI framework”, “firm-wide AI training”, AI-vendor governance with Compliance, Legal, Technology and Engineering, a designated AI support channel, and tracking of “token and platform usage costs across all AI tools” (company claim; the role is unfilled and the programme is described only by the advertisement)
entries.title: AI operations vacancy describes an existing program
bullets: The advertisement names embedded teams, ROI tracking, training and vendor governance; it does not establish that the role is filled.

entries.source_note: Houston Endowment launches a pilot "to use Zoom AI tools to record and transcribe virtual meetings between program officers and grantees from its civic engagement program", replacing written portal reports with 45–90 minute recorded oral interviews (date derived from the Chronicle of Philanthropy's "last year" in its 1 October 2025 report)
entries.title: Zoom AI pilot begins for grantee interviews
bullets: Houston Endowment replaces written reports with recorded oral interviews in a civic-engagement pilot.

entries.source_note: Houston Endowment publishes its own account of the pilot: grantees "participate in virtual, semi-structured interviews that are recorded, transcribed, and summarized using AI tools"; the pilot's findings and lessons were "recently shared at the Grantmakers for Effective Organizations (GEO) national conference"; and "Insights from the pilot are already shaping Houston Endowment's internal learning and grantmaking strategies" (company claim — no volume or accuracy figure disclosed)
entries.title: AI interview pilot informs internal learning
bullets: The foundation describes recording, transcription and summaries, with early findings shaping grantmaking; no volume or accuracy metric is given.

entries.source_note: Chronicle of Philanthropy reports the AI reporting pilot has concluded and that Houston Endowment "is expanding its oral reporting to other programs, such as its arts and culture grant-making portfolio" — AI is not named in the expansion — and records the human-verification step: Endowment "staff review transcripts of the oral reports and correct any misspellings or other errors"
entries.title: Oral-reporting pilot concludes and expands
bullets: Staff verify transcripts; the report does not explicitly confirm AI use in the newly added programs.

entries.source_note: Houston Endowment's own November–December 2025 Channel newsletter reports that Evaluation Officer Robiel Abraha and IT Manager Eddie Mazariegos presented "From Reporting to Reflection: Using AI to Reimagine Grantee Feedback" at the Technology Association of Grantmakers annual conference, describing "the cross-team collaboration that has led to Houston Endowment's success with using AI for grantee reporting" (company claim — no success measure is given)
entries.title: Staff present AI grantee-reporting experience
bullets: A conference presentation describes collaboration behind the pilot, without quantifying its success.

entries.source_note: In a post on its 2026 Grantee Perception Report, Houston Endowment lists "piloted oral reporting" among the practices it introduced in response to earlier grantee surveys — hyperlinking the phrase to its own AI pilot page — and reports grantees saying "oral reporting" is among the "practices we should continue and deepen in coming years"; AI is not mentioned anywhere in the post
entries.title: Grantee feedback supports continuing oral reporting
bullets: The post links to the AI pilot but does not itself mention AI or establish additional deployment.

entries.source_note: BNPP AM publishes “Quant investing in 2026”, stating that the firm “recently incorporated global patent filings into our investment process — a dataset comprising millions of pages of text”, with processing time cut from about a month to about a week (company claim), and that “AI enhances the process — humans remain firmly in control”
entries.title: AI processes patent filings for quantitative investing
bullets: BNPP AM claims processing time fell from about a month to a week, while humans remain in control.

entries.source_note: A BNPP AM quantitative researcher/portfolio manager details the patent dataset in production use — “over 37 million entities” — and states the firm uses “a proprietary model that combines LLMs with graph theory” to identify innovative firms for asset-allocation decisions (company claim)
entries.title: Proprietary patent model combines LLMs and graph theory
bullets: The research team describes over 37 million entities used to identify innovative companies for allocation decisions.

entries.source_note: BNP Paribas's Asset Management investor Deep Dive lists AI already in production at BNPP AM — a coding agent, “~70 specialized agents processing unstructured data to accelerate investment workflows”, “GenAI content automation for RFPs & marketing, delivering ~15% productivity gains”, “Quant Multi-Factor allocation at scale (€18bn AuM) in portfolio construction” and AI-assisted due diligence with “secure copilot agents & LLM research tools” — under the strategic enabler “Tech, Digital & AI” (all company claims)
entries.title: Investor presentation lists production AI applications
bullets: BNPP AM claims about seventy specialist agents, AI-assisted diligence and roughly 15% productivity gains in content automation.

entries.source_note: In a BNPP AM Talking Heads podcast transcript, Quant Equity CIO Ram Rasaratnam describes NLP models of earnings-call sentiment and management precision feeding the firm's quality signal, an open-source LLM “that we host internally on our own CPUs” exposing the team's model code to natural-language query and writing code into the repository (“still testing out at the early stages”), and a governance gate requiring team sign-off before any human- or machine-written code reaches production
entries.title: Investment signals use NLP; coding assistant still testing
bullets: BNPP AM describes live sentiment inputs and an experimental internal LLM, with team approval required before code reaches production.

entries.source_note: Capital Group publishes an “AI, Authenticity and Hiring” statement on its own domain setting out four guiding pillars — transparency, privacy, equity and responsible use — for AI in its hiring process, prohibiting candidate AI tools during interviews and disclosing that the firm itself “may use AI responsibly to support our recruiting efforts, for example, to transcribe internal notes or improve process efficiency” (company claim)
entries.title: Hiring statement sets four AI-use principles
bullets: Capital Group permits possible recruiting support under transparency, privacy, equity and responsible-use rules; the wording does not confirm deployment.

entries.source_note: Microsoft names Capital Group among organizations that had early access to Copilot Cowork and quotes SVP of Enterprise Technology Barton Warner saying the firm has used Copilot since its 2024 launch and that Cowork will help it “automate and scale the Copilot ecosystem” (company claim, vendor-hosted)
entries.title: Capital Group receives early Copilot Cowork access
bullets: Microsoft quotes the firm on Copilot use since 2024 and plans to automate more of its ecosystem.

entries.source_note: ITPro reports the Copilot Cowork rollout and states that Copilot “has helped the investment management firm automate a range of tasks”, carrying Warner's quotes in full
entries.title: ITPro reports Copilot-assisted task automation
bullets: The coverage repeats Capital Group’s executive account of its existing Copilot use and Cowork rollout.

entries.source_note: Capital Group posts a Principal Product Manager of AI Measurement & Reporting role on its own careers site, describing an existing Enterprise AI team that tracks and prioritises “AI use cases across all business lines” against the firm's Long-Term Strategic Plan, maintains “a centralized inventory of AI use cases”, and runs intake, approval and financial-validation processes for new AI use cases
entries.title: AI measurement vacancy describes enterprise governance
bullets: The role names a centralized use-case inventory, prioritization, approvals and financial validation within an existing AI team.

entries.source_note: A Capital Group Senior Machine Learning Engineer posting describes an existing “AI Insights team” building “multi-agent systems that answer investment questions with citations” and “agents that take on expert analyst workflows end-to-end” on top of Capital Group's investment data, with work reaching “across the investment organization, from research analysts to governance specialists to the teams behind portfolio and order management”
entries.title: Engineering vacancy describes investment-research agents
bullets: The AI Insights team is building cited answers and analyst workflows; an advertisement alone does not establish production reach.

entries.source_note: A Capital Group AI Senior Manager, AI Engineering posting, reporting to an AI Engineering Director, asks the hire to “translate Capital Group’s AI-first operating model into practical transformation across investment systems” through MVPs and “human-plus-agent” patterns — future-tense transformation work, not shipped production
entries.title: Senior AI role targets investment-system transformation
bullets: The posting seeks prototypes and human-plus-agent workflows; the described transformation is future work.

entries.institution: CDPQ (Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec)
entries.source_note: CDPQ's 2023 Annual Report lists, among the year's operational-risk measures, "The implementation of a governance framework to ensure the ethical and responsible use of artificial intelligence in all our activities, whether investment-related or not"; in the same report President and CEO Charles Emond names "the use of data science and artificial intelligence in our activities" among the initiatives building a modern CDPQ, and the Board received 2023 training on "Technology and artificial intelligence"
entries.title: AI governance framework introduced
bullets: CDPQ’s annual report describes responsible-use controls across activities, alongside data-science initiatives and board education.

entries.institution: CDPQ (Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec)
entries.source_note: La Presse reports that C$25 billion of depositors' money sits in global equity portfolios that have for two years been under systematic management relying on AI tools, and quotes VP Quantitative Strategies and Data Science Jean-François Bérubé describing ~75,000 data points a day across a 1,500-company universe and the use of generative AI to score earnings-call language complexity as one of those inputs (company claims on both the amount and the outperformance)
entries.title: AI-supported systematic equities reach C$25bn
bullets: La Presse reports company figures and generative-AI analysis of earnings-call language across a 1,500-company universe.

entries.institution: CDPQ (Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec)
entries.source_note: CDPQ's 2024 Annual Report has the President and CEO state that CDPQ has "launched various projects to leverage the full potential of technology, including expanding our use of artificial intelligence and improving analytical tools to better exploit data, enhance decision-making and, ultimately, generate superior performance"; the Board's 2024 training included "Generative artificial intelligence and data management for public investors", and "Quantitative Strategies and Data Science" appears as a standing unit on the organisational chart
entries.title: Annual report describes expanding AI projects
bullets: CDPQ names analytics improvements, board GenAI training and a standing Quantitative Strategies and Data Science unit.

entries.institution: CDPQ (Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec)
entries.source_note: La Presse, reporting CDPQ's 2024 results, writes that for three years CDPQ has run quantitative investing with AI-developed technologies through its "Gestion fondamentale systématique" team and that C$25 billion is now managed with the quantitative team's algorithms, inside an equity portfolio of more than C$129 billion that is 70% internally managed (company claims)
entries.title: Results coverage confirms quantitative investment scale
bullets: La Presse reports C$25bn managed with the team’s algorithms, based on CDPQ’s account.

entries.institution: CDPQ (Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec)
entries.source_note: La Caisse's 2025 Annual Report records "The implementation of a governance framework for artificial intelligence, including generative AI, both for deploying in-house solutions and for assessing the associated risks" among the year's operational-risk measures, and in Equities lists "Advanced data science capabilities, resulting in the deployment of new systematic strategies", crediting the launch of systematic strategies leveraging "augmented intelligence" with a significant impact on the Equity Markets portfolio's five-year value added
entries.title: Governance and new systematic strategies documented
bullets: La Caisse reports controls for in-house AI and claims augmented-intelligence strategies contributed to equity value added.

entries.institution: CDPQ (Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec)
entries.source_note: In a La Presse column reporting an executive-committee reshuffle, CEO Charles Emond says roughly C$30 billion of La Caisse's C$120 billion equity portfolio is now managed with the help of artificial intelligence and that the tool drove notable outperformance (company claim); responsibility for analytics data and technological transformation moves to incoming COO Sarah-Émilie Bouchard, and Emond states that AI-based quantitative management serves rather than displaces the traditional manager
entries.title: AI-assisted equity management reaches roughly C$30bn
bullets: The CEO reports expanded scale and outperformance, while emphasizing support for traditional managers rather than replacement.

entries.source_note: IMCO's 2023 Annual Report states the organization has “begun to evaluate how Generative AI may be applicable for IMCO”, expects it will not “replace functions for the near future”, and is looking at it to streamline “administrative and repeatable tasks”; it also says IMCO is collaborating with its desktop, data and HR service partners to access their maturing AI functionality
entries.title: GenAI evaluation focuses on administrative tasks
bullets: IMCO explores repeatable workflows and vendor capabilities, without expecting near-term replacement of functions.

entries.source_note: IMCO's 2024 Annual Report reports that in 2024 IMCO “documented a list of over 70 use cases to develop a prioritized roadmap for GenAI” as part of applying generative AI to its Investment Excellence and Cost Efficient Operations pillars, and that these efforts “will inform our AI policy” — i.e. no AI policy yet in place
entries.title: More than seventy candidate AI use cases documented
bullets: IMCO develops a prioritized roadmap; an AI policy remains a future output of that work.

entries.source_note: IMCO's 2025 Annual Report states that in 2025 IMCO “finalized a strategic AI framework” built on “Value-Driven AI Solutions”, an “AI-Ready Culture” and “Responsible Governance and Oversight”, claims it is “already seeing productivity benefits” from deeper AI integration (company claim — no tool, team or measure named), and says it “completed detailed communication, training and other execution plans for an enterprise-wide rollout of Microsoft 365 Copilot™”; the CEO's letter describes this as having “launched a strategy governing our adoption of artificial intelligence (AI)”
entries.title: Strategic framework finalized; Copilot rollout planned
bullets: IMCO claims early productivity benefits without metrics and completes training and communication plans for enterprise deployment.

entries.source_note: IMCO's 2025 Annual Report describes a new people-leader program, “Talk it Out: Navigating Difficult Conversations with Confidence”, whose sessions “featured both peer and AI-based role-playing scenarios and feedback” — the only concretely named internal AI use disclosed anywhere in the public record
entries.title: AI role-playing supports leadership training
bullets: IMCO names a difficult-conversations program using AI scenarios and feedback alongside peer exercises.

entries.source_note: Neuberger Berman partners with Microsoft to launch its own "NB ChatGPT" pilot programme; the firm reports more than 1,700 users across the organisation at year-end using it for tasks such as translation and in departments including finance (company claim — no independent verification, and no usage rate beyond headcount)
entries.title: NB ChatGPT pilot reaches over 1,700 users
bullets: Neuberger reports cross-department exploration including translation and finance; headcount is not a measured usage rate.

entries.source_note: Neuberger Berman publicly discloses that internal adoption in "Gen AI: The Next Wave", a dated insight piece by Senior Research Analyst Daniel Flax whose closing section describes the NB ChatGPT pilot, the 2017 Data Science team and the 2018 quantitative-boutique acquisition, and claims the firm is "already seeing" AI redirect time away from repetitive and labor-intensive tasks (company claim)
entries.title: Public account describes NB ChatGPT pilot benefits
bullets: Neuberger claims less time on repetitive tasks and provides historical data-science context, without independent verification.

entries.source_note: A Neuberger fund summary prospectus filed with the SEC, dated 18 December 2025 and amended and restated 10 February 2026, discloses that the fund and its adviser "may utilize artificial intelligence (“AI”) technologies, including machine learning models and generative AI, to improve operational efficiency and in connection with research", and that "the Manager may restrict certain uses of AI tools" — permissive risk-factor wording, not a deployment claim
entries.title: Prospectus permits possible AI use
bullets: The filing discusses research, efficiency and restrictions through risk-factor language; it does not confirm a new deployment.

entries.source_note: The foundation established an internal Global AI Task Force as "a coordinating mechanism to define the role of AI as it relates to the foundation's work", disclosed by CEO Mark Suzman in a 21 May 2023 post on the foundation's own site; the same post says an external ethics and equity advisory committee was being established
entries.title: Global AI Task Force established
bullets: The Gates Foundation creates an internal coordinating mechanism and plans an external ethics and equity advisory committee.

entries.source_note: A Lead Platform Engineer requisition on the foundation's own Workday site states that the Enterprise Data Solutions team, inside Business Operations and IT, "recently launched the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) - the central hub for managing, analyzing, and sharing the Foundation's data assets and enabling AI", and scopes the role to multi-year Data and AI platform roadmaps and design patterns for governing agentic AI (company claim — job-posting text, no deployment or usage disclosed)
entries.title: Platform vacancy names AI-enabling data infrastructure
bullets: The advertised role covers future data and agent-governance roadmaps; it supplies no deployed AI application or usage figure.

entries.source_note: A Senior AI Engineer requisition on the foundation's own Workday site describes the Knowledge Mgmt & Insights group as "an AI-first team" using LLMs and knowledge graphs, and the team's central work as "an AI-powered intelligent data and AI platform that enables employees to discover and interact with connected knowledge through conversational experiences"; it also requires experience with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Codex for internal development (company claim — job-posting text, platform described as under development)
entries.title: AI engineering vacancy describes knowledge-platform development
bullets: The team is building conversational access to connected knowledge; the advertisement does not establish completed deployment.

entries.source_note: KKR's 2024 Corporate Sustainability Disclosures document a Generative AI Policy that "sets forth the governance structures, guidelines and requirements regarding the use of generative AI at KKR" and list "Continued KKR's Generative AI Working Group" among the year's Data Responsibility highlights
entries.title: Generative AI Policy and working group documented
bullets: KKR’s sustainability disclosures describe governance structures and requirements for internal generative-AI use.

entries.source_note: Gaurav Hind joins KKR to lead ADAPT, described on KKR's own people page as "the firm's global AI, Data, Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering organization", responsible for "building and operating KKR's core technology platforms, spanning AI engineering, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and site reliability"
entries.title: ADAPT organization gains a new leader
bullets: Gaurav Hind takes charge of KKR’s global AI, data, infrastructure and platform-engineering organization.

entries.source_note: KKR's 2025 Corporate Sustainability Disclosures (published June 2026, covering calendar year 2025) list "Advanced KKR's Responsible AI Governance and Oversight Program" as a 2025 highlight and describe a firm-wide Responsible AI Policy plus "a formal, cross-functional governance process that evaluates proposed AI tools and use cases" which "approves implementation only when the technology meets our standards for responsible use", supported by "mandatory firm-wide training"
entries.title: Responsible AI program adds approval gates and training
bullets: KKR describes cross-functional review before implementation and mandatory training across the firm.
